Dear Friend,
Today marks 8 weeks out from Election Day. To put that into perspective, I launched my campaign 386 days ago. There are 56 days left.
That means we have 56 days to strengthen our coalition of Tennesseans who have had enough of Governor Bill Lee’s extreme politics. We have 56 days to decide the direction of healthcare, women’s rights, and public education in this state. Every issue is on the ballot — we simply cannot sit out this election.
This campaign has achieved a lot since we started last August. We’ve toured all 95 counties, met countless folks across the state, and won the Democratic primary to take on Bill Lee this November. There’s so much more we can achieve in these next 8 weeks, as long as I can count on your support.
Can you please make a contribution to strengthen this campaign going into these final 8 weeks? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/primarywintn]

body:
I am honored to once again be the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in New Hampshire.
#

It's official -
I am honored to once again be the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in New Hampshire.
With the primary now behind us, I wanted to take a moment to say thank you to you. At every turn, the backing of people just like you has allowed us to build a campaign that this team can and should be proud of.
With the general election now officially underway, we’ll need to redouble our efforts. [**That’s why I’m coming to you today to ask if you will split $5 between Cheri Beasley and me and become a General Election Founding Donor.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-mh-split.V0dJDh&refcode=em220913-3-ma&t=1&akid=1720%2E357359%2Ep2k9So)
The fight to protect this seat – and with it, our Democratic Senate majority – is only going to get harder. Just like with Cheri in North Carolina, the smear campaign is only going to intensify, and the over $53 million the GOP is spending against me is only going to increase.
But you know what I say? **Bring. It. On.**
I’ve never been one to run from a challenge, and there is too much on the line in this race to back down. Whether it’s continuing to deliver real solutions on the issues that matter most, or blocking a McConnell nationwide abortion ban, it all begins with winning here in New Hampshire and Cheri’s race in North Carolina.
And I hope that Cheri and I can count on your support as we fight to do just that, because the final sprint to the finish line starts right now. And it starts with you.
We need people like you in this fight, because the fate of our Democratic Senate majority will hinge on our key battleground races. [**So please, split a $5 contribution between Cheri Beasley and me and join this team as a founding donor of the general election.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-mh-split.V0dJDh&refcode=em220913-3-ma&t=2&akid=1720%2E357359%2Ep2k9So)

name: John Fetterman
subject: They introduced a national abortion ban
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
Screw that. We won’t let it happen.
#
Derek,
Earlier today, Lindsey Graham introduced a national abortion ban in the U.S. Senate. While announcing it, he summed up exactly why defeating Dr. Oz + winning this race is so important:
_“If [the GOP] takes back the House and the Senate, then I can assure you we’ll have a vote on the [national abortion ban].**If the Democrats are in charge, I don’t know if we’ll ever have a vote on our [ban].”**_
We MUST grow our Democratic majorities in the House and Senate so we can stop these abortion bans and finally codify _Roe v. Wade_ into law. And our best shot at growing that majority in the Senate is right here in PA, Derek.
**[Please consider rushing a donation of $5 or more if you can today. With your support, I can be the 51st Democratic vote in the Senate to shut down these abortion bans and defend abortion access across the country.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220913-3?amount=5&refcode=em20220913-7236&refcode2=7236_434096__WD-d2&akid=7236%2E434096%2E_WD-d2)**
**[Contribute $5](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220913-3?amount=5&refcode=em20220913-7236&refcode2=7236_434096__WD-d2&akid=7236%2E434096%2E_WD-d2)**
Normally I would take the time here to share my views on abortion — but you already know where I stand on the issue, Derek. **I’ve always made my full and complete support for abortion + reproductive rights known.**
Instead, I’m here to ask a simple question:
**Where does Dr. Oz stand on a national abortion ban?**
You may remember that *just* during this campaign, Oz has:
> ❌ Called _Roe v. Wade_ “wrong”
> ❌ Said he supports a ban on abortions with no exceptions for rape or incest
> ❌ Called all forms of abortion, at any stage at any time, “murder”
Yet, Oz refuses to plainly tell the voters of Pennsylvania how he would vote on national abortion bans like the one introduced today. **He thinks that he can use his TV talk show mumbo-jumbo to get out of answering the tough questions, but we see right through that.**
Oz + the GOP don’t care that a majority of Americans support _Roe_. They don’t care that access to safe abortion saves lives. They don’t care that parenthood should always be a choice.
They don’t care that the right to choose what happens to your body + your future is a non-negotiable, fundamental, HUMAN right.
**We can’t let them get away with this.**
Oz + the Republicans are on a radical mission here — and they’re dumping tens of millions of dollars into our race in PA because they know this seat is critical to retaking their majority + outlawing abortion nationwide.
But if we’re going to defeat the GOP + their super PACs, and achieve the 51 Democratic vote we need to protect the right to an abortion, we have to rise to the moment:
**[Rush a donation of $5 or any amount today to help us win this race, flip this seat, and protect the right to an abortion. We can’t afford to lose this race when so much is on the line.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220913-3?amount=5&refcode=em20220913-7236&refcode2=7236_434096__WD-d2&akid=7236%2E434096%2E_WD-d2)**
Thank you,
John ❤️
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate
P.S. The sh*t the GOP is pulling with this proposed abortion ban is so wrong and so heavy. Please remember to step away from the news if you need to, especially while they spout their harmful lies across Fox News.

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220913-7236-footer&t=1&refcode2=7236_434096__WD-d2&akid=7236%2E434096%2E_WD-d2)**

body:
Please, let me explain why this is such a dire moment:
| | |
---
Friend: With only 3 hours left to meet my $200,000 fundraising goal at midnight, **I'm still falling short****.** Please, let me explain why this is such a dire moment:
**I'm just 1 POINT behind Marco Rubio in a race that will determine Senate control, and Politico has just INCREASED my chances of defeating Rubio!**
The problem is that Marco Rubio and national Republicans are launching desperate attacks against me because they know that if I win in Florida, Democrats can expand our Senate majority and federally protect reproductive freedom by codifying _Roe v. Friends,

I thought I’d take a second to tell you how I got here – running for the U.S. Senate. There’s so much to tell, and I want all of you to know why I am so determined to fight for the forgotten men and women of this country. Let me give you the Sparknotes version of my _Hillbilly Elegy._
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=af83ff1c08c24e4180e4d10b6f5751e1&_e=YVsISHldh1QuIliMosDqZ6YKUjYnM_jfruzrT8ulX8LvbfVi4SzIQBt6MtpEDypJUc2uJK_mVu4qSjF5Znpafy_7WVi1VJVZHvTtckCFpgkboFLJzKnDshkuZDjZN2Thb0Q3P1ZrDd4MDE76x7vRJeUu_mSVlB_5N-arsvuovLfFJWnDRzozUcEF0KdA4I23SnKBiS-CSQAqdbWIDIVFTlA1a2JES8aLxeHO8crFW3VrNQV-UY8rH9wJJFBcv-00_9321t2jxYqNonf4oHzsSIggGfRXtJWH2MP5b4eJxYxfviD7AyyEl84Q47RoDvJQEr_9-S6fDBDMiJQ47UIeepcfbnarxBVpyAVrZ3NXo4xAVtaQSlq4OO0obt3KqRDqrylD6hA8lKVQ4XiRSd6OU2L1lwl5hZ50LlAw-nRd4uBdWZAiWY8lrh7shtKeTnhmD_3NTZ-4B4ibjhUgxLqrxnIf5_gbA3yQzAoLLHPQFO4%3D)
This is a photo of my sister, Lindsay, and me. We grew up in the manufacturing town of Middletown, Ohio. We grew up in a dysfunctional house without a constant father figure. My mother struggled with drug and alcohol addiction. I recall an episode when I was eleven when my mother and I got in a heated argument and I climbed into the back of the car. She eventually pulled over, I got out of the car, and she chased me across a field. The drama and family turbulence was nonstop.
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=af83ff1c08c24e4180e4d10b6f5751e1&_e=YVsISHldh1QuIliMosDqZ6YKUjYnM_jfruzrT8ulX8LvbfVi4SzIQBt6MtpEDypJUc2uJK_mVu4qSjF5Znpafy_7WVi1VJVZHvTtckCFpgkboFLJzKnDshkuZDjZN2Thb0Q3P1ZrDd4MDE76x7vRJeUu_mSVlB_5N-arsvuovLfFJWnDRzozUcEF0KdA4I23SnKBiS-CSQAqdbWIDIVFTlA1a2JES8aLxeHO8crFW3VrNQV-UY8rH9wJJFBcv-00_9321t2jxYqNonf4oHzsSIggGfRXtJWH2MP5b4eJxYxfviD7AyyEl84Q47RoDvJQEr_9-S6fDBDMiJQ47UIeei3QQ0zBSECt4_j7pVMdawOmkVK5EpIxOW9W8UeTt0U8m8vgDYJjTHKYb_Dh1OOF3Sjq8DI9B72ufbfkf6z_2_OUCKDd4DFa-6Gn8Ri-z9j7EeaVs-LTv8ZjmLciZ5Rbb3V9KUsQ4HQe2MKF5d-PB3U%3D)
My sister and I eventually moved in with my grandparents – Mamaw and Papaw. Pictured here is me and Mamaw. Her and Papaw were, without question or qualification, the best things that ever happened to me. They spent the last two decades of their lives showing me the value of love and stability and teaching me the life lessons that most people learn from their parents. Both did their part to ensure that I had the self-confidence and the right opportunities to get a fair shot at the American Dream.
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=af83ff1c08c24e4180e4d10b6f5751e1&_e=YVsISHldh1QuIliMosDqZ6YKUjYnM_jfruzrT8ulX8LvbfVi4SzIQBt6MtpEDypJUc2uJK_mVu4qSjF5Znpafy_7WVi1VJVZHvTtckCFpgkboFLJzKnDshkuZDjZN2Thb0Q3P1ZrDd4MDE76x7vRJeUu_mSVlB_5N-arsvuovLfFJWnDRzozUcEF0KdA4I23SnKBiS-CSQAqdbWIDIVFTlA1a2JES8aLxeHO8crFW3VrNQV-UY8rH9wJJFBcv-00_9321t2jxYqNonf4oHzsSIggGfRXtJWH2MP5b4eJxYxfviD7AyyEl84Q47RoDvJQEr_9-S6fDBDMiJQ47UIeepUyp-H6BLBHldhEEYx8_6QVWBj4j9E2OplGILIunyOY0rmYSo_jZZEzCPk19mZl1FBSRRjnTjsTw02AoZGonPIte2r3dJOQErkbQN48WNYVkpSw8Zu6Py4sb6cGUD3UuiqS2vEsoQDJK0ClyhKDo_s%3D)
After high school, I decided to enlist in the Marine Corps. I served in the Iraq War performing public affairs activities. I served for four years before returning home to Ohio, where I became a first-generation college graduate at the Ohio State University.
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=af83ff1c08c24e4180e4d10b6f5751e1&_e=YVsISHldh1QuIliMosDqZ6YKUjYnM_jfruzrT8ulX8LvbfVi4SzIQBt6MtpEDypJUc2uJK_mVu4qSjF5Znpafy_7WVi1VJVZHvTtckCFpgkboFLJzKnDshkuZDjZN2Thb0Q3P1ZrDd4MDE76x7vRJeUu_mSVlB_5N-arsvuovLfFJWnDRzozUcEF0KdA4I23SnKBiS-CSQAqdbWIDIVFTlA1a2JES8aLxeHO8crFW3VrNQV-UY8rH9wJJFBcv-00_9321t2jxYqNonf4oHzsSIggGfRXtJWH2MP5b4eJxYxfviD7AyyEl84Q47RoDvJQEr_9-S6fDBDMiJQ47UIeekEqiL8hDHN2rIeeQx8kplRAuqBnoDKp0xJROC-0LA4z8asbXJpRvFvqrm9RunIH0zSnhu18RPXT2_zJkCiM49KBbJLW1WnTcmbjgliJoZowYeozcyYXWp6Rt5cpbqnbWTKCFHNgj3N3pTDUpK93h78%3D)
I then went on to attend Yale Law School, where I met the love of my life, Usha. She showed me kindness and patience, all while guiding me through the trauma and baggage I held onto from my childhood. We married in 2014 and now have three beautiful children together.
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=af83ff1c08c24e4180e4d10b6f5751e1&_e=YVsISHldh1QuIliMosDqZ6YKUjYnM_jfruzrT8ulX8LvbfVi4SzIQBt6MtpEDypJUc2uJK_mVu4qSjF5Znpafy_7WVi1VJVZHvTtckCFpgkboFLJzKnDshkuZDjZN2Thb0Q3P1ZrDd4MDE76x7vRJeUu_mSVlB_5N-arsvuovLfFJWnDRzozUcEF0KdA4I23SnKBiS-CSQAqdbWIDIVFTlA1a2JES8aLxeHO8crFW3VrNQV-UY8rH9wJJFBcv-00_9321t2jxYqNonf4oHzsSIggGfRXtJWH2MP5b4eJxYxfviD7AyyEl84Q47RoDvJQEr_9-S6fDBDMiJQ47UIeeu4qA8cUQbeLpmdWnl0Of5TWq3zd5pr3gmxaDwEnU0V3kIOV14q0j8b5-NhoocTHXQd3fpbG_55S3N47gNKlA5iFAqZZNparOCGIVxgLnTvfo9lR3ztOx6an0JS3DeUMwcEi8G_NpJzinDqZNfvnzLo%3D)
All of this brought me to where I am right now – campaigning to be Ohio’s next Senator. After the success of my book, I began working to fiercely defend working-class Americans against the media and political elite who have ignored us for so long. I’ve seen too many lives devastated by job loss, addiction, and economic turmoil to stay silent.

I think so many politicians are lost in the establishment. They fail their constituents, their country, and ultimately – they fail themselves. It’s an industry of broken promises and corrupt practices. But I will never stoop to that level. My roots – my family – my hometown – are what got me here. The good and the bad.
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=af83ff1c08c24e4180e4d10b6f5751e1&_e=YVsISHldh1QuIliMosDqZ6YKUjYnM_jfruzrT8ulX8LvbfVi4SzIQBt6MtpEDypJUc2uJK_mVu4qSjF5Znpafy_7WVi1VJVZHvTtckCFpgkboFLJzKnDshkuZDjZN2Thb0Q3P1ZrDd4MDE76x7vRJeUu_mSVlB_5N-arsvuovLfFJWnDRzozUcEF0KdA4I23SnKBiS-CSQAqdbWIDIVFTlA1a2JES8aLxeHO8crFW3VrNQV-UY8rH9wJJFBcv-00_9321t2jxYqNonf4oHzsSIggGfRXtJWH2MP5b4eJxYxfviD7AyyEl84Q47RoDvJQEr_9-S6fDBDMiJQ47UIeemDLGYBkyTQaoQEXAGIZEsYbdGT5no0Rcw2UAPZQtvvQa9nXG3vzpwxq5EskNSXEvRGCYDNcmciXbeVMTzE7hy9sgATA837N-180zji-I0LL9HwyL2S3IUiQvHPSdG56M9hYUdcjFhLp68296eNGp8Y%3D)
I will never let you down or leave you behind. The Senate needs someone who knows what it’s like to live in a left-behind community, not a career politician who has done nothing for the people of Ohio.

I feel incredibly lucky and blessed to be where I am. Looking through these pictures reminds me of the core of this campaign: **leave no Ohioan behind.**

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: We face a real challenge
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Beto for Texas
body:
The challenges we face today are the greatest in living memory. Historic
attacks on the right to vote, on a woman's right to choose, and on our
children's right to be free of gun violence will either destroy this great
state or will be overcome by the resolve and power of the people of Texas.

Greg Abbott has prioritized extreme fringe policies instead of expanding
health care, fixing the grid, or improving public education. He signed the
nation’s most extreme abortion bill into law with no exception for rape or
incest. And he refuses to lift a finger to reduce gun violence after six
major mass shootings have occurred on his watch.

Despite all of that — or maybe because of all of that — Texans are
standing up to be counted in the fight for a far better Texas. It's
inspiring how the people of this great state are choosing to meet the
moment. Already, 90,000 volunteers have signed up for voter contact shifts
to reach millions of voters wherever they are across Texas. And we have
taken this campaign to literally every part of the state — showing up for
everyone and writing no one off.

But we face a real challenge in overcoming the millions of dollars that
Greg Abbott was able to raise from special interests before we ever
entered the race. He'll use that to lie to voters about my record and try
to keep them from turning out. And there's a chance he'll succeed if we
don't have the resources to fight back.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220913-3.8rXn-Y&refcode=ema20220913-207714&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=207714%2E444211%2Ek_uDn2 ]So I need your help to make sure we can hire
more organizers, open new field offices, run ads, and ultimately reach all
of the voters who will decide this election. Will you make a
$3 contribution today to help us raise $2,500,000 before
midnight on Thursday?

We have less than two months to win this election, and we need everyone to
give everything they've got. I will continue to relentlessly travel this
state, meet with as many voters as physically possible — but I also need
the resources to overcome Abbott’s money advantage if we're going to win.

Now is the time to focus everything we have on overcoming and winning.
It's never been more important or urgent.

Let's do this.
Beto

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures 👉
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277839:6T6KBdVpN:m:1:3331421248:365F03D79748595534BD02B65B37419A:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277839:6T6KBdVpN:m:1:3331421248:365F03D79748595534BD02B65B37419A:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277839:6T6KBdVpN:m:1:3331421248:365F03D79748595534BD02B65B37419A:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277839:6T6KBdVpN:m:1:3331421248:365F03D79748595534BD02B65B37419A:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277839:6T6KBdVpN:m:1:3331421248:365F03D79748595534BD02B65B37419A:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277839:6T6KBdVpN:m:1:3331421248:365F03D79748595534BD02B65B37419A:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277839:6T6KBdVpN:m:1:3331421248:365F03D79748595534BD02B65B37419A:r "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an
advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277839:6T6KBdVpN:m:1:3331421248:365F03D79748595534BD02B65B37419A:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277839:6T6KBdVpN:m:1:3331421248:365F03D79748595534BD02B65B37419A:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique
problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, Peter. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277839:6T6KBdVpN:m:1:3331421248:365F03D79748595534BD02B65B37419A:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277839:6T6KBdVpN:m:1:3331421248:365F03D79748595534BD02B65B37419A:r "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277839:6T6KBdVpN:m:1:3331421248:365F03D79748595534BD02B65B37419A:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277840:6T6KBdVpN:m:1:3331421248:365F03D79748595534BD02B65B37419A:r "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277840:6T6KBdVpN:m:1:3331421248:365F03D79748595534BD02B65B37419A:r "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277840:6T6KBdVpN:m:1:3331421248:365F03D79748595534BD02B65B37419A:r "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")

---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277842:6T6KBdVpN:m:1:3331421248:365F03D79748595534BD02B65B37419A:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for
your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277842:6T6KBdVpN:m:1:3331421248:365F03D79748595534BD02B65B37419A:r "Step up now!")**_

body:
That's all the time we have left until the biggest midterm race in American history.
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278667:JEQzZdVNp:m:1:3299561967:D8B2B2719F34A1A0E1613503BCF4B3A0:r)
2 months. 8 weeks and change. 1,400 hours. 86,000 minutes.
That's all the time we have left until the biggest midterm race in American history.
Patriot, **it 's crunch time.** I know you're a very busy person so believe me when I say this: Election Day will be here before you know it.
Even sooner will be the day when it's too late to do anything more to protect my seat from flipping Blue.
The truth is, _no election is won on election day._ Competitive races like mine are decided in the final months and weeks of a campaign. In other words, the time to defeat my Far Left opponent is **RIGHT NOW!**
[**SAVE YOUNG 'S SEAT!**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278667:JEQzZdVNp:m:1:3299561967:D8B2B2719F34A1A0E1613503BCF4B3A0:r)
---
In order to turn out enough conservative voters on Election Day, we have no choice but to ramp up volunteer recruitment, spread our positive ads across my district, host more events, and print yard signs and flyers like we've **NEVER SEEN BEFORE.**
All of this must be done in the coming weeks, and the time to fund our FINAL campaign push is NOW. And all that effort costs our campaign lot of money.
[**Will you kindly help me once more to finish this race strong so we can win big in November and help Republicans restore our House majority?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278667:JEQzZdVNp:m:1:3299561967:D8B2B2719F34A1A0E1613503BCF4B3A0:r)
[**SAVE YOUNG 'S SEAT!**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278667:JEQzZdVNp:m:1:3299561967:D8B2B2719F34A1A0E1613503BCF4B3A0:r)
---
Even just a small donation can go a long way in a race this big.
Your faithful support to my campaign is not lost on me. Thanks for ALL you've done.
Yours truly,
Young Kim

__
* * *
__
_We 'll get straight to the point: _
__
_We are completely dependent on grassroots support to fuel our efforts against the Democrats._
__
__YOU are the reason Young is in Congress today, and YOU will be the reason she 's able to continue our fight for small business support, lower taxes, slashing red tape, cutting back unnecessary government spending, more educational opportunities for our children, fixing our broken immigration system, and keeping the American Dream alive for generations.__
__
_[_**So, we 're humbly asking for $25, $50, $100, or a greater amount to help keep my seat so I can keep fighting for you.**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278668:JEQzZdVNp:m:1:3299561967:D8B2B2719F34A1A0E1613503BCF4B3A0:r)_

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278472:6kFBZdVjN:m:1:3317145305:02085B47A3815C9BC27BEFD381479A02:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278472:6kFBZdVjN:m:1:3317145305:02085B47A3815C9BC27BEFD381479A02:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278472:6kFBZdVjN:m:1:3317145305:02085B47A3815C9BC27BEFD381479A02:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278472:6kFBZdVjN:m:1:3317145305:02085B47A3815C9BC27BEFD381479A02:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278472:6kFBZdVjN:m:1:3317145305:02085B47A3815C9BC27BEFD381479A02:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278472:6kFBZdVjN:m:1:3317145305:02085B47A3815C9BC27BEFD381479A02:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278472:6kFBZdVjN:m:1:3317145305:02085B47A3815C9BC27BEFD381479A02:r "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an
advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278472:6kFBZdVjN:m:1:3317145305:02085B47A3815C9BC27BEFD381479A02:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278472:6kFBZdVjN:m:1:3317145305:02085B47A3815C9BC27BEFD381479A02:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique
problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, Peter. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278472:6kFBZdVjN:m:1:3317145305:02085B47A3815C9BC27BEFD381479A02:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278472:6kFBZdVjN:m:1:3317145305:02085B47A3815C9BC27BEFD381479A02:r "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278472:6kFBZdVjN:m:1:3317145305:02085B47A3815C9BC27BEFD381479A02:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278473:6kFBZdVjN:m:1:3317145305:02085B47A3815C9BC27BEFD381479A02:r "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278473:6kFBZdVjN:m:1:3317145305:02085B47A3815C9BC27BEFD381479A02:r "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278473:6kFBZdVjN:m:1:3317145305:02085B47A3815C9BC27BEFD381479A02:r "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278474:6kFBZdVjN:m:1:3317145305:02085B47A3815C9BC27BEFD381479A02:r "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278475:6kFBZdVjN:m:1:3317145305:02085B47A3815C9BC27BEFD381479A02:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking
for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278475:6kFBZdVjN:m:1:3317145305:02085B47A3815C9BC27BEFD381479A02:r "Step up now!")**_

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side. | "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq" When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned. | "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned." " It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--and won. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress. | "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress." My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol. body:
[](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjjkuil-ttjjilthht-r/) Dear Peter, One of the best things about running for Governor is traveling all over our beautiful state. In my journeys across the mountains of the western slope, to the eastern plains, and the urban centers along the front range, I have seen first-hand that our transportation system is broken. **It's time to "fix the damn roads."** Colorado has the 46th worst roads in the country. Three years ago, Jared Polis made a $5.4 billion investment in a plan he said "would finally fix the damn roads." In reality, only one out of every three dollars created by SB21-260 goes to roads and bridges in CDOT's ten-year plan. Driving gives you the freedom to get where you want when you want. We can't let Jared Polis take away this freedom from us. **Thursday, September 15th at 10 a.m. I will lay out my transportation plan on the steps of CDOT: 2829 West Howard Pl, Denver, CO 80204**. [](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjjkuil-ttjjilthht-y/) [**Read the full press release here.**](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjjkuil-ttjjilthht-j/) I spent this past weekend out on the Western Slope. It's unfortunate, but not unexpected, that Jared Polis didn't show up for our first debate. The Western Slope deserves better! **As your governor, I will show up for the ENTIRE state.** Read my editorial in the Durango Herald about how I will be a governor for ALL people. name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures ➡
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278511:6vnstdVQN:m:1:3253819041:C870E4E18032D03F85AE000CC1619DB7:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278511:6vnstdVQN:m:1:3253819041:C870E4E18032D03F85AE000CC1619DB7:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278511:6vnstdVQN:m:1:3253819041:C870E4E18032D03F85AE000CC1619DB7:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278511:6vnstdVQN:m:1:3253819041:C870E4E18032D03F85AE000CC1619DB7:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278511:6vnstdVQN:m:1:3253819041:C870E4E18032D03F85AE000CC1619DB7:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278511:6vnstdVQN:m:1:3253819041:C870E4E18032D03F85AE000CC1619DB7:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278511:6vnstdVQN:m:1:3253819041:C870E4E18032D03F85AE000CC1619DB7:r "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an
advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278511:6vnstdVQN:m:1:3253819041:C870E4E18032D03F85AE000CC1619DB7:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278511:6vnstdVQN:m:1:3253819041:C870E4E18032D03F85AE000CC1619DB7:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique
problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, Peter. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278511:6vnstdVQN:m:1:3253819041:C870E4E18032D03F85AE000CC1619DB7:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278511:6vnstdVQN:m:1:3253819041:C870E4E18032D03F85AE000CC1619DB7:r "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278511:6vnstdVQN:m:1:3253819041:C870E4E18032D03F85AE000CC1619DB7:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61278514:6vnstdVQN:m:1:3253819041:C870E4E18032D03F85AE000CC1619DB7:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for

subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6053%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=NoL%2bwgeFJETyhNiDNv4HEQ&sysid=1)
I wanted to share these special moments with you.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85064%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2bIO0teQnVAnXWCJjqjzNlg&sysid=1 "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85075%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=BAmZBQYzEkQvMQ7f8wdbgQ&sysid=1 "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85076%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=AqWZ0JktKm2pbPwjfkzLjA&sysid=1 "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty’s side.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85077%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=cBuVcnNb0vGviHDX7SCQQQ&sysid=1 "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty’s immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85078%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=28Gh2eGzxFvfrFkWaii9wg&sysid=1 "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran
gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85079%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=T%2f8qnUNiWBxBr3tKNPg%2bvg&sysid=1 "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer,
breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It’s not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85070%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YP9yCzk%2b9tDCkxOC5ZrQZQ&sysid=1 "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for
our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to ‘see’ our children’s faces, he’s always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85071%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kskcNYUYxRXEYTHfC4SDug&sysid=1 "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I’ve shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85072%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2b5iTbntxHpSBko%2flojGDcg&sysid=1 "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and
end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can’t do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85073%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=pLyBiwIl7DYUWTJ%2bGdgFVQ&sysid=1 "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks
to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85074%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bQyRQVHIlYv9pbd2oJSeTw&sysid=1 "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85085%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=NBhdjdf18FHRuf1ZPcq7YQ&sysid=1 "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85086%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=HlXNQ2z1GSsmq3Ko6gmo2w&sysid=1 "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it’s Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can’t make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85087%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0VEYZllljCt9nxJRZVScDw&sysid=1 "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let’s raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85088%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=C8HKVdJyxP6gXG9xKwLLHA&sysid=1 "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85089%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=SVb6Kf0wT3tB1MxLXZD%2fng&sysid=1 "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85080%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=dp2ZkI%2fLEiiFrJwAqatQOQ&sysid=1 "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help
in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85081%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2bDK0E%2fhE2sKOuLL7H%2fAipA&sysid=1 "Step up now!")**_

I grew up in Iowa. There’s not a lot to do there, but that’s where I honed my work ethic. I worked hard. I learned to fight. I gained that fighting spirit the old establishment GOP never had -- that’s what makes me a part of the NEW RIGHT. Someone even recently told me “Kari, you’re going to be the DeSantis of the West.” Other than being called “Trump in a Dress” -- which is my favorite compliment of all -- that is the greatest compliment you could pay me. **To me, that means that you know when you elect me, you’re going to get someone who fights for you every single day. ** We are going to be so effective in Arizona.
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zn1mrnfr1l5kj6hb0be5b0q8ok4auca8qbcj9emg_rp22sh2s8i66or6chgm9pr4chh2bs)
---
**Friend, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden’s ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Make no mistake... My opponent would be a NIGHTMARE to the pro-freedom, pro-America agenda we want to implement. Here’s what you should know about Katie Hobbs. ➡️ **_SHE WILL NOT DEFEND YOUR RIGHT TO BEAR ARMS!_** Katie has an F grade when it comes to protecting our Second Amendment rights. I don’t know about you, but I feel that our Second Amendment is the most important amendment right now. _It’s the reason that we are still free. _ **_➡️ HER VOTING RECORD IS SHOCKING!_** She’ll never talk about it, but 90% of the time when she was in our state legislature, she voted against small businesses. 90 percent! **_➡️ SHE FAILED TO SECURE OUR ELECTIONS._** Hobbs served as Secretary of State in 2020 in one of the most corrupt elections in American history. **_➡️ SHE IS A CONVICTED RACIST!_** Two separate juries unanimously convicted her of racial discrimination, and the taxpayers of Arizona are paying for her crimes! Almost $3 million as a payout for her court settlement because she did not pay Black employees the same as she paid white employees. _That is disgusting._
We cannot afford to let a radical lefty like Katie Hobbs turn Arizona into another California.**__**_[**Will you help me defeat her?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zueo87rn16jb76812r2sft5g28r5ho0sk0hn7lag_rp22sh2s8i66or6chgm9pr4chh2bs)_
---
Now, I don’t care if you’re with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1gj28gdc0bfb2snhs28ks7cv5h4ka3t85o3j3e0_rp22sh2s8i66or6chgm9pr4chh2bs)_. ** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**
---

name: Great America Update
subject: For a limited time
body:
The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6322%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=O5OiWZIn5ZhPRs1jVBawyg&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75347%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uLG02j39FDcjliypnmdDkQ&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American,
The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. They’ve shaken me, and I’m sure they’ve affected you as well.
Throughout it all, you may have noticed a recurring theme from the progressives in the media, Big Tech, and politics. They insist that the government designed by our Founding Fathers, as expressed in the Constitution, is **flawed** and **outdated** --not adequate for the challenges of our time.
How should defenders of the Constitution, like you and me, respond to such charges?
Well, a few early champions of the Constitution--Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison--have given you the guide: _The Federalist Papers_.
Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution.
Thomas Jefferson described _The Federalist Papers_ as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.”
That means that defenders of the Constitution have no better help in understanding the principles of liberty underlying our Constitution than the words of the Founders themselves.
**So, I’d like to send you our entire 10-lesson course, “ _The Federalist Papers_ ,”on DVD today with a donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**
_**“The Federalist Papers”**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. It’s taught by Hillsdale’s knowledgeable faculty and will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more.
The DVD can also make an excellent gift for a friend or family member unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles of liberty. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75348%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=P6D82erMO%2by7eg0W7xZDRg&sysid=1) Supplies are limited, though, so get this special edition of **_“The Federalist Papers”_** on DVD today. Given that more than 200,000 people have taken this course already, you can bet the DVD box set won’t last long.
Click here to learn more about this DVD and order your copy of _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ today: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-federalist-papers**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75349%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6Q6164WhOJxddlyESZivfA&sysid=1)
Warm regards,
Bill Gray
Class of 2001
Associate Vice President of National Donor Outreach
Hillsdale College

subject: ENOUGH IS ENOUGH.
body:
| | | [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61280080:JxrcFdVNc:m:1:3317145305:14B4549935A3ECFB712DDA49A94F141E:r)
---
| | Peter, Are there any sane Democrats left who will call out Joe Biden for his insults? He is calling every conservative American a "semi-fascist." He's threatening to use the might of the federal government to murder Republicans. And not one member of the political establishment - including my opponent - will stand up to him. They always agree with everything Joe Biden says because everything he does keeps THEM in power. ENOUGH IS ENOUGH. It's time to fight back and make the government work FOR THE PEOPLE. Not against us!**__**_[**Are you with me?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61280080:JxrcFdVNc:m:1:3317145305:14B4549935A3ECFB712DDA49A94F141E:r)_**_ _**
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE NOW >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61280080:JxrcFdVNc:m:1:3317145305:14B4549935A3ECFB712DDA49A94F141E:r)
---
I'm telling you right now that I am a strong conservative who can get things done. I'm the transformative leadership we need. _But you don't need to just take my word for it. _ **I'm endorsed by:**
* * * * * * President Donald Trump
* Governor Ron DeSantis
* Rudy Giuliani
* Marjorie Taylor Green
* Sheriff Joe Arpaio
* Richard Grenell
* General Michael Flynn, and more...

---
[**JOIN PRESIDENT TRUMP: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61280080:JxrcFdVNc:m:1:3317145305:14B4549935A3ECFB712DDA49A94F141E:r)
---
Together, we're going to unite to solve the problems America is facing right now. And trust me...there's a lot to do.
_But I know I can make it happen because I 've always been able to do anything I set my mind to. And that's not going to stop now!_
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61280080:JxrcFdVNc:m:1:3317145305:14B4549935A3ECFB712DDA49A94F141E:r)
---
[ ](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61280080:JxrcFdVNc:m:1:3317145305:14B4549935A3ECFB712DDA49A94F141E:r)
---
I grew up in Iowa. There's not a lot to do there, but that's where I honed my work ethic. I worked hard. I learned to fight. I gained that fighting spirit the old establishment GOP never had -- that's what makes me a part of the NEW RIGHT. I developed that backbone of steel - that "BDE" that President Trump and Governor Ron DeSantis have. And frankly, that we want all of our elected leaders to have. Someone even recently told me "Kari, you're going to be the DeSantis of the West." Other than being called "Trump in a Dress" -- which is my favorite compliment of all -- that is the greatest compliment you could pay me. **To me, that means that you know when you elect me, you 're going to get someone who fights for you every single day. ** We are going to be so effective in Arizona.
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61280080:JxrcFdVNc:m:1:3317145305:14B4549935A3ECFB712DDA49A94F141E:r)
---
**Peter, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden 's ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Make no mistake... My opponent would be a NIGHTMARE to the pro-freedom, pro-America agenda we want to implement. Here's what you should know about Katie Hobbs. ➡️ **_SHE WILL NOT DEFEND YOUR RIGHT TO BEAR ARMS!_** Katie has an F grade when it comes to protecting our Second Amendment rights. I don't know about you, but I feel that our Second Amendment is the most important amendment right now. _It 's the reason that we are still free. _ **➡️ _HER VOTING RECORD IS SHOCKING!_** She'll never talk about it, but 90% of the time when she was in our state legislature, she voted against small businesses. 90 percent! **➡️ _SHE FAILED TO SECURE OUR ELECTIONS._** Hobbs served as Secretary of State in 2020 in one of the most corrupt elections in American history. **➡️ _SHE IS A CONVICTED RACIST!_** Two separate juries unanimously convicted her of racial discrimination, and the taxpayers of Arizona are paying for her crimes! Almost $3 million as a payout for her court settlement because she did not pay Black employees the same as she paid white employees. _That is disgusting._
We cannot afford to let a radical lefty like Katie Hobbs turn Arizona into another California.**__**_[**Will you help me defeat her?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61280080:JxrcFdVNc:m:1:3317145305:14B4549935A3ECFB712DDA49A94F141E:r)_
---
Now, I don't care if you're with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61280080:JxrcFdVNc:m:1:3317145305:14B4549935A3ECFB712DDA49A94F141E:r)_. ** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**
---
[**SAVE AMERICA: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61280080:JxrcFdVNc:m:1:3317145305:14B4549935A3ECFB712DDA49A94F141E:r)
---
Sincerely,

body:
I wanted to take a moment to say thank you
| | |
---
Friend –

I am honored to once again be the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in New Hampshire.
With the primary now behind us, I wanted to take a moment to say thank you, friend. At every turn, the backing of people just like you has allowed us to build a campaign that this team can and should be proud of.
**With the general election now officially underway, we’ll need to redouble our efforts.[ That’s why I’m coming to you today to ask if you will split $5 between Jacky Rosen and me to become a General Election Founding Donor before our critical mid-month deadline.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50671658/366771642/1332402004?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk1994-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MjQzOGU3My0yYzM0LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rNnmWhbmNEkYCBn9e9FwjscjwsY-klzhBzWVezkMR00=)**
The fight to protect this seat – and with it, our Democratic Senate majority – is only going to get harder. The smear campaign is only going to intensify, and the over $53 million the GOP is spending against me is only going to increase.
But you know what I say, friend?******Bring. It. On. **
I’ve never been one to run from a challenge, and there is too much on the line in this race to back down. Whether it’s continuing to deliver real solutions on the issues that matter most to Granite Staters, or blocking McConnell's nationwide abortion ban, it all begins with winning here in New Hampshire.
**And I hope that I can count on your support as we fight to do just that, because the final sprint to the finish line starts right now. And it starts with you. **

body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61281679:JFpWUdVeN:m:1:3331421248:FC4C6D6A89D01BF40172927BD56D4607:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

body:
We’re getting to the bottom of the Mar-a-Lago raid, and we need your help | | | Fellow patriot, Former President Trump is going on the offensive and appears to be launching a full-scale fight against the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI). We here at the America First Policy Institute are joining the fight. I’m sure you already know the backstory: The FBI recently raided former President Trump’s home in what could be politically-motivated. This ordeal should paint a clear picture for us: The deep state is real, and we can’t afford to sit around playing defense while the FBI raids a former President’s home. **_We MUST go on the offensive._** [**And that’s exactly what I plan to do. Will you help me?**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=8a92eda882bb4818a159577d0a4b165f&_e=Jd158TibvXyE7dk0C78xb0KWa7lmjL6QQjwfctFHh9U1LboUo35YkFHFG0SyWynJFf9gqOQ5cHotGA_O80a0kjtiP8g6DEgx_p3KR0i4Ek2rS_MsFzmJtN82lyliqcmduzaTLfrqzS_-TTeDCFP9dDhaOxHmc_5d5jL4bf0MrOCOkdrOOY61z5BdRSWEnGBSD5_ebfB4X-H0Puq7nBDVzCZDPFegGDRHkP_egok9N8BERXw7gJqtILxOnw9txpDyX3PTVD54Vb_Dq9ez-Av6l3LtEMRXCi7tbhXVML3XsZFFtnx-rxd8lgb9kAmdS5ALTicRbaIVk5ZroijZ060h3otSBPClVI87iBa0h6Bt-h-gkp_36hzf_AqBWgyjR9t-nguxcMN2UxhReai8dbjOK2priLlVekx8oJSCdA5tqQg%3D) _Our country is at risk of crumbling into a banana republic run by the most radical leftists in America and an invulnerable deep state. WE HAVE NO CHOICE BUT TO FIGHT BACK!_ When the news broke, our entire team sprung into action to respond. Within 48 hours, we filed more than 50 Freedom of Information Act requests to expose the Biden Administration and find out who knew what and when. But I assure you, the Department of Justice (DOJ) is not going to hand over information easily, and we may have to battle with the DOJ for months or even YEARS to uncover the truth fully. **We CANNOT sustain our efforts without you...** **[Will you chip in before it’s to help ensure our efforts can continue?](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=8a92eda882bb4818a159577d0a4b165f&_e=Jd158TibvXyE7dk0C78xb0KWa7lmjL6QQjwfctFHh9U1LboUo35YkFHFG0SyWynJFf9gqOQ5cHotGA_O80a0kjtiP8g6DEgx_p3KR0i4Ek2rS_MsFzmJtN82lyliqcmduzaTLfrqzS_-TTeDCFP9dDhaOxHmc_5d5jL4bf0MrOCOkdrOOY61z5BdRSWEnGBSD5_ebfB4X-H0Puq7nBDVzCZDPFegGDRHkP_egok9N8BERXw7gJqtILxOnw9txpDyX3PTVD54Vb_Dq9ez-Av6l3awqqQA3wWbeVhd_QgleTz9tOaKw8d21vQ61aGY-_XoIpxzKRcDE5JVwu_mNUoccuefGwRpxuuvU0KyWCP_xorkxV6NS0-Ss7Tbw4K8nNPO1XRk8A-xKuQMNitZ_s5CKTbhRWys-KtUkkK39IF0Ec4%3D)**[ ](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=8a92eda882bb4818a159577d0a4b165f&_e=Jd158TibvXyE7dk0C78xb0KWa7lmjL6QQjwfctFHh9U1LboUo35YkFHFG0SyWynJFf9gqOQ5cHotGA_O80a0kjtiP8g6DEgx_p3KR0i4Ek2rS_MsFzmJtN82lyliqcmduzaTLfrqzS_-TTeDCFP9dDhaOxHmc_5d5jL4bf0MrOCOkdrOOY61z5BdRSWEnGBSD5_ebfB4X-H0Puq7nBDVzCZDPFegGDRHkP_egok9N8BERXw7gJqtILxOnw9txpDyX3PTVD54Vb_Dq9ez-Av6lxNeUWU9L48hT6mcCoGvLYziXqbDTkNkxTfOt2ReIKBsNDj2brTJgV8Wqz-z5I8WtKwudkOoYl9rO3tlm4jewB5yfKuRfw_B9YGQi_GOoAt0uCvXJRHmcB0x-lRaRbHjUiquVRvZTTKwTSWDRo76FwQ%3D) Let me back up. My name is Matt Whitaker... I was appointed acting United States Attorney General under former President Trump. In that role, I protected Law and Order both at home and abroad. Today I am Co-Chair of the Center for Law & Justice at the America First Policy Institute, where we strive to protect and preserve the rule of law in this great Nation. Together, we will fight back against the radical Left and end its unjust weaponization of the FBI. The team at America First Policy Institute is the best in the Nation, and we’re ready to make a HUGE difference for our country—ESPECIALLY when it comes to uncovering the truth regarding the FBI raid. [**I hope you’ll consider sending in a donation of $15, $25, or $50 today. ** ](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=8a92eda882bb4818a159577d0a4b165f&_e=Jd158TibvXyE7dk0C78xb0KWa7lmjL6QQjwfctFHh9U1LboUo35YkFHFG0SyWynJFf9gqOQ5cHotGA_O80a0kjtiP8g6DEgx_p3KR0i4Ek2rS_MsFzmJtN82lyliqcmduzaTLfrqzS_-TTeDCFP9dDhaOxHmc_5d5jL4bf0MrOCOkdrOOY61z5BdRSWEnGBSD5_ebfB4X-H0Puq7nBDVzCZDPFegGDRHkP_egok9N8BERXw7gJqtILxOnw9txpDyX3PTVD54Vb_Dq9ez-Av6l4bopSNDj01DBB347pJy46_zA7c8-LmoOHLoQRt1eSwdYoUiXzQlJREttLH4EBWt0hxsogT39l-aaawRo82hga8PHfrH4-HvB2A31ohYpDoVkk9zd3NGyVN0-CdOWrWNiPHMOCBLlgWAWMVL2qk0TjA%3D) Sincerely, Matt Whitaker Co-Chair, Center for Law & Justice America First Policy Institute P.S. We’ve seen it time and time again. Castro’s Cuba. Stalin's Russia. Nazi Germany. Mao’s China. Great nations fall to tyranny when governments weaponize law enforcement against patriots and political opponents. [**I’ll fight with every breath to make sure that America doesn’t have the same fate. Will you? ** ](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=8a92eda882bb4818a159577d0a4b165f&_e=Jd158TibvXyE7dk0C78xb0KWa7lmjL6QQjwfctFHh9U1LboUo35YkFHFG0SyWynJFf9gqOQ5cHotGA_O80a0kjtiP8g6DEgx_p3KR0i4Ek2rS_MsFzmJtN82lyliqcmduzaTLfrqzS_-TTeDCFP9dDhaOxHmc_5d5jL4bf0MrOCOkdrOOY61z5BdRSWEnGBSD5_ebfB4X-H0Puq7nBDVzCZDPFegGDRHkP_egok9N8BERXw7gJqtILxOnw9txpDyX3PTVD54Vb_Dq9ez-Av6lzxxCPaGVHNKtsZQrd0E967ss3X-_UZHc2wYzQ4w8uxdDF8O5UmhujjXwK-MeigiBriuoVxWoajS3J-QhRn6Zq9W0KtEQ8rMqAf_J1o8pVmmMnwf_amEvoQlM_4J47TR8xtYGApLF8NI6Ahek2Tn0ds%3D)

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5d05ccade2aa491dbc984e27a442acf2&_e=jCpSJdB2JOQtcSIKrj9KKZXxEon8oQBcjfr7DKtN-7hYVu2bNgoWq9QcROqG7v-7rO6hbMQQIdO5D5OySzYmtez-MvhHypeYgD3-Dpx331wW2s_H4jbgrCV7KPtRbcNHXLAf6rg4IdtdQpzF_7FJ2RpCN3xQjIiDl9M2XsvgkQR_XExYsRA7EmW-NqWS2xGfioCOfrKiUC6c16hGoPgUoJ_BRzn7mzFtr0KFyUuR2NklwtLnNuuQlaCiTbQHUEKCYaoW-CjJJVn8Gf_jW_hnmMhvz8CwyAFvkCgIkQ15V0_XkoGqaSpai2KAOucphYvU6YDVW4rhJ1nRrB9XCxCI7w8vp3JLjfNpkBoLBes27asFIvo_2x5vg-q9QBNQjOAuigRWe-qnfw0W6oRMOWIt2w%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5d05ccade2aa491dbc984e27a442acf2&_e=jCpSJdB2JOQtcSIKrj9KKZXxEon8oQBcjfr7DKtN-7hYVu2bNgoWq9QcROqG7v-7rO6hbMQQIdO5D5OySzYmtez-MvhHypeYgD3-Dpx331wW2s_H4jbgrCV7KPtRbcNHXLAf6rg4IdtdQpzF_7FJ2RpCN3xQjIiDl9M2XsvgkQR_XExYsRA7EmW-NqWS2xGfioCOfrKiUC6c16hGoPgUoJ_BRzn7mzFtr0KFyUuR2NlbshVfWXpbs2xrff_kfBrRkcNjupG0_Gpy7lFJc-r8QPoyxuAnXPYU69Xq9G9IPQngiipEIMCgXGImenehJ4un1qYQkCFTsxULCQWlCyieeU3egE1o85o0Sl5-7zl_GmxRzg9inu3LbAacA7PMKs4EmSqpU2VeQwnuxMsAG6dliw%3D%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5d05ccade2aa491dbc984e27a442acf2&_e=jCpSJdB2JOQtcSIKrj9KKZXxEon8oQBcjfr7DKtN-7hYVu2bNgoWq9QcROqG7v-7rO6hbMQQIdO5D5OySzYmtez-MvhHypeYgD3-Dpx331wW2s_H4jbgrCV7KPtRbcNHXLAf6rg4IdtdQpzF_7FJ2RpCN3xQjIiDl9M2XsvgkQR_XExYsRA7EmW-NqWS2xGfioCOfrKiUC6c16hGoPgUoJ_BRzn7mzFtr0KFyUuR2Nn7he07dYNI7zbucAEKPkW8FH5kBP3xnHpJbbIn3qU4XRfumT-vA8AqkMhW1FvyFjh8GHmnru8s3MjF1OZSnYGJpgFu1bLqGqScZ92U3XlhDPflj3i79CcikmGRPiM7MT-dqDd0KsdvZyv9Un3w0yYna1GUrOOesuitx6NhUy1a8Q%3D%3D)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Yesterday, Lindsey Graham proposed a national abortion ban. | | |
---
| | Dear Peter, We knew this was coming. Republicans have hinted at it since _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned.
**Yesterday,**[**Lindsey Graham proposed a national abortion ban**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50681515/366811941/-1468916170?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ3MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZWZjMmJiNS0zOTM0LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-zg-owQBN09i0b6iwC8jiOQs_ikI4MEkqDiF6ts3OUY=&emci=70f5ea08-b833-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=cefc2bb5-3934-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=25616296)**. **

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50681517/366811942/-440390766?refcode=email091422&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ3MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZWZjMmJiNS0zOTM0LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-zg-owQBN09i0b6iwC8jiOQs_ikI4MEkqDiF6ts3OUY=)
