Lindsey Graham is being deliberately deceitful by calling this a “late-term abortion ban.” We won’t allow him to perpetuate that lie. It’s an all out federal ban on abortion – plain and simple. If Lindsey Graham and the GOP get their way, there will be no more safe haven states. Abortion will be illegal in every corner of the United States. Period. **We have to stop them. If Democrats hold the House and flip just two Senate seats, we can secure abortion rights and stop this federal abortion ban dead in its tracks.** That’s where Pennsylvania comes in. It is crucial that we help get John Fetterman across the finish line in November. We simply cannot trust his out-of-touch, anti-abortion opponent, Mehmet Oz to be the deciding vote in the Senate. Those are the stakes. [**That’s why we’ve organized a Rapid Response Fund to defend our pro-choice Democratic candidates who will fight against abortion bans at every level.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50681518/366811945/-440390766?refcode=email091422&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ3MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZWZjMmJiNS0zOTM0LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-zg-owQBN09i0b6iwC8jiOQs_ikI4MEkqDiF6ts3OUY=)

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277389:60EN8HVN_:m:1:3345639852:3F7BD6BE01DC956E32EBD0549CFED962:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277389:60EN8HVN_:m:1:3345639852:3F7BD6BE01DC956E32EBD0549CFED962:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277389:60EN8HVN_:m:1:3345639852:3F7BD6BE01DC956E32EBD0549CFED962:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277389:60EN8HVN_:m:1:3345639852:3F7BD6BE01DC956E32EBD0549CFED962:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277389:60EN8HVN_:m:1:3345639852:3F7BD6BE01DC956E32EBD0549CFED962:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277389:60EN8HVN_:m:1:3345639852:3F7BD6BE01DC956E32EBD0549CFED962:r "I will always
stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277389:60EN8HVN_:m:1:3345639852:3F7BD6BE01DC956E32EBD0549CFED962:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277389:60EN8HVN_:m:1:3345639852:3F7BD6BE01DC956E32EBD0549CFED962:r "Washingtonians
need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277389:60EN8HVN_:m:1:3345639852:3F7BD6BE01DC956E32EBD0549CFED962:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277389:60EN8HVN_:m:1:3345639852:3F7BD6BE01DC956E32EBD0549CFED962:r "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---

---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---

Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277390:60EN8HVN_:m:1:3345639852:3F7BD6BE01DC956E32EBD0549CFED962:r "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

SMILEY")
---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277391:60EN8HVN_:m:1:3345639852:3F7BD6BE01DC956E32EBD0549CFED962:r "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277392:60EN8HVN_:m:1:3345639852:3F7BD6BE01DC956E32EBD0549CFED962:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61277392:60EN8HVN_:m:1:3345639852:3F7BD6BE01DC956E32EBD0549CFED962:r "Step up now!")**_

#
In this campaign, we are challenging all of the conventional wisdom with a nominee for U.S. Senate unlike North Carolina has ever seen before.
Cheri’s won statewide twice before, so she knows what it takes to win. That’s why when we launched this campaign, she made clear that we couldn’t settle for the old, failed playbook.
We had to try something new — a grassroots campaign that touches every corner of the state and truly gives people a voice.
That bet is paying off in big ways. Poll after poll shows us in a dead heat, and now far-right super PACs are taking note of our momentum and rushing in with tens of millions of dollars to try to hold this seat.
But there are real obstacles to taking on the conventional wisdom and running a campaign like this. Plus, **history shows that there’s a consistent trend of underfunding for women and people of color who run for office.** On average, African American women running for Congress raised only about HALF of what white candidates raised according to the Center for Responsive Politics’ analysis.
That’s why our mid-month fundraising deadline at midnight tomorrow is so critical. Between the ramped-up GOP spending and the FEC deadline, all eyes are watching to see if Cheri and this grassroots team can defy history.

body:
Raphael Warnock and his millions of dollars in campaign cash haven't let up yet.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61283746:Jaxn8HVoN:m:1:3253819041:DB7459828FA581A012075EE55CD1284A:r "Football") Peter: I know it's easy to see the headline that Herschel Walker has pulled ahead of Leftist Raphael Warnock in the latest poll and think, "it's over, we won." If you feel that way, you're no different from Leon Lett, who celebrated on the 2-yard line only to have the ball swiped away before he reached the end zone. There is too much, WAY TOO MUCH, at stake in this Senate race for us to let up one bit. Because I promise you, Raphael Warnock and his millions of dollars in campaign cash haven't let up yet. Now is the time to strike even harder to ensure that Herschel wins on election day. In 2020, New Journey PAC put tremendous resources into Georgia, and we need to double our efforts for the remainder of this election if we're going to turn out the Black voters who will vote for a Republican candidate for the first time in their life and deliver a victory for Herschel. **[That's only going to happen if you chip in $25, $50, or $1000 today to help us bring Black voters to the GOP so they cast their votes for Herschel and other Republican candidates this November.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61283746:Jaxn8HVoN:m:1:3253819041:DB7459828FA581A012075EE55CD1284A:r "That’s only going to happen if you chip in $25, $50, or $1000
today to help us bring Black voters to the GOP so they cast their votes for Herschel and other Republican candidates this November.")** Listen, Schumer's lapdog Raphael Warnock has already been cleaning up on the fundraising... $85 million at the latest count. And the Democrats are just starting to launch their smears against Herschel. Make no mistake, I fully expect they will dump hundreds of millions in this race trying to stop Herschel from winning, especially now that Herschel has pulled ahead by the slightest of margins. [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61283746:Jaxn8HVoN:m:1:3253819041:DB7459828FA581A012075EE55CD1284A:r "Headline")And let me tell you, the focus of the Democrats will be to target the black vote. They know that the black vote has been the impetus for Georgia turning from a solidly Red State to a Purple Battleground State. Even, the media credited the record Black turnout for Warnock's win last year. But I refuse to cede the Black vote to the Democrats. Why you ask? Because I know we can win them over and bring them to the GOP. We've done it before and can do it again! At New Journey PAC, we know how to get Black voters to break the chains of their Democrat masters by showing them the GOP is the true party of freedom and prosperity and we believe this message is ripe for this year's election. **Herschel Walker is an American Dream Story. While his opponent believes America is a "Bad Country Full of Racist people," Herschel believes we are "a great country!"** **[Can I count on you to join our Georgia outreach to the Black voters in the Peach State? We need you to donate $50, $100, or $250 today to help Herschel win.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61283746:Jaxn8HVoN:m:1:3253819041:DB7459828FA581A012075EE55CD1284A:r "Can I count on you to join our Georgia outreach to the Black voters in the Peach State? We need you to donate $50, $100, or $250 today to help
Herschel win.")** While we've got the winning strategy that will cement Herschel's victory, we just don't have enough money to fully implement our plan. [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61283746:Jaxn8HVoN:m:1:3253819041:DB7459828FA581A012075EE55CD1284A:r "Headline")It's the same proven plan that got Burgess Owens and Byron Donalds elected to Congress and Winsome Sears elected as the first Black Lieutenant Governor in Virginia! Herschel is right when he says that Raphael, Biden, and the Left use race to divide us. But the only way we're going to get Black voters to hear that message and unite with Republicans of all shades and colors is if you step up today. **[That's why we need you to dig deep on this one. With all the money pouring into Georgia from the Leftist activists across the country, a $5 or $10 donation isn't going to cut it.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61283746:Jaxn8HVoN:m:1:3253819041:DB7459828FA581A012075EE55CD1284A:r "That’s why we need you to dig deep on this one. With all the money pouring into Georgia from the Leftist activists across the country, a
$5 or $10 donation isn’t going to cut it.")** Don't believe the media. We CAN take back the majority in the Senate. But only if you help us bring Black Georgians over to the GOP. **[You can make that happen with your donation today.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61283746:Jaxn8HVoN:m:1:3253819041:DB7459828FA581A012075EE55CD1284A:r "You can make that happen with your donation today.")** For a New Journey, [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61283746:Jaxn8HVoN:m:1:3253819041:DB7459828FA581A012075EE55CD1284A:r "James Golden, AKA Bo Snerdley")

| | | __**[You may not know me, so let me share my story.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zt3s4n5tge80gk580eukcmvmio18mksa7iu0rcpg_rp22sh2s8i66or6chjm1ob1cdh2bs "You may not know me, so let me share my story.")**__
My name's Tiffany Smiley. I'm a mom of three, veteran's wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I'm running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring **real change** to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

>From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty _**earned**_ as an active duty service member, and I _**won**_.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to **advocate for _all_ veterans**, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

Now, I need _your_ help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.

---
| | [HELP TIFFANY'S CAMPAIGN](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z8v3bj3jj53mb08bsj594ne1nm2hgemdhjovl0uo_rp22sh2s8i66or6chjm1ob1cdh2bs "HELP TIFFANY’S CAMPAIGN")
---

Murray has been in office for _**three decades**_ and has done **nothing** to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I'm running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the failed leadership they've been stuck with for _years_.

It's time for a _**change**_ in D.C., and I'm the right person for the job.

The latest polls in Washington show that my opponent and I will be _**neck and neck**_ , and I'm getting nervous. We're _finally_ closing in on Murray, but I need your support to cross the finish line.

_**[Can you chip in any amount to help me take the lead to save Washington?](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zk8k20ijbhijspp0mg11ukip25p2s0ua52on5j8g_rp22sh2s8i66or6chjm1ob1cdh2bs "Can you chip in any amount to help me take the lead to save Washington?")**_

Your support will bring me closer to restoring the American dream from the U.S. Senate.

---
| | [SUPPORT TIFFANY](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zmol99mc1ss8bggmvgg6o1u4uonqhup9l52af3i8_rp22sh2s8i66or6chjm1ob1cdh2bs "SUPPORT TIFFANY")
---

To victory,

Tiffany Smiley

---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zu8aafauej50qf4rh2ir76n7hd9fc3h328u1vf9o_rp22sh2s8i66or6chjm1ob1cdh2bs "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zcg244t2g3ghcdi24d0u1aeaueofcldrsfgm62gg_rp22sh2s8i66or6chjm1ob1cdh2bs "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zd577r7b4sqn59lf9s3r7287cm6ef50cnpriv3go_rp22sh2s8i66or6chjm1ob1cdh2bs "Step up now!")**_

In a moment, **[I’m going to ask if you can pitch in a contribution to help us hit our goal](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50681706/366812536/-2123748265?refcode=fl_email_fr_20220914mm2letmeexplain_wm_odpf90ds_SLA_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMGZjMmJiNS0zOTM0LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jttTTFFEOY3uuV39cu1wHNLxJTYpqX4G-rmbFXh-DsE=)** , but before I do, I hope you’ll let me explain how important your support is right now. **Today, we’re just 55 days out from Election Day, our opportunity to give Maryland the bold, compassionate leadership our state deserves.** Aruna and I are ready to deliver work, wages, and wealth for every Marylander — we have detailed plans to address education, gun violence, climate change, public transit, economic opportunity, and so much more. But this election isn’t just about electing leaders who are committed to making progress on the key issues facing our state. It’s also about stopping a dangerous candidate who pushes conspiracy theories, denies election results, and aims to rip basic rights — like abortion access and free, fair elections — away from Marylanders. There’s a clear path before us: _move forward or backward._ **This election is your chance to make your voice heard, to vote like your rights and the future of our state depend on it. Because they do.** We have less than two months left to make that clear to every voter across Maryland, and it takes a whole lot of money to reach that many people in such a short amount of time. That’s why Friday’s goal is crucial: every dollar will help ensure we can keep our TV ads on the air, our digital ads online, our signs up across the state and our organizers in the field so we can spread our message. **[Will you help us reach our mid-month goal by pitching in $10 or whatever amount is meaningful to you today? I appreciate each and every contribution you make to our movement.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50681707/366812537/-2123748265?refcode=fl_email_fr_20220914mm2letmeexplain_wm_odpf90ds_SLA_l2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMGZjMmJiNS0zOTM0LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jttTTFFEOY3uuV39cu1wHNLxJTYpqX4G-rmbFXh-DsE=)** Let’s do everything we can in these final weeks to win this historic opportunity for change and move Maryland forward. | | Governor J. B. Pritzker signed the grossly misnamed SAFE-T Act into law, and it will go into effect on January 1. This bill completely overhauls our criminal justice system and endangers Illinoisans in the process. The SAFE-T Act, or more accurately, the Unsafe Act, ends cash bail in Illinois, making us the first state in the country to do so. Democrats argue that it’s unfair to hold someone in jail because they don’t have the funds to post bail. But what is truly unfair is how innocent Illinoisans will be put in harm’s way as dangerous criminals will now be set free in our neighborhoods because of this bill. Lauren Underwood refuses to tell voters where she stands and continues to vote with defund-the-police extremists like AOC and the squad, while our families are put in danger by reckless left-wing policies. She has even been campaigning with anti-police radical State Rep. Delia Ramirez. Abolishing cash bail means that any suspected criminal currently sitting in jail awaiting trial will be let out beginning January 1, 2023. It means that people facing charges for violent offenses like fatal DUIs, drug distribution, or kidnapping (just to name a few) will all be scot-free until their trial date. The elimination of cash bail means that the criteria for arresting a suspected criminal will be more difficult to meet, forcing police officers to arrest less suspects out of fear of punishment, essentially handcuffing them from performing the duties of their career. This directly jeopardizes the safety of every man, woman, and child across our state. This is the Democrat agenda, and this is the party of Lauren Underwood. She does not care about your safety or your family’s safety. She does not care about upholding the rule of law, but rather actively seeks to undermine it. The Unsafe Act is a threat to our home, and unless we vote out Lauren Underwood and her Democrat friends in November, Illinois families shouldn’t expect the chaos and crime to subside any time soon. clean_body: | | | | | Governor J. B. Pritzker signed the grossly misnamed SAFE-T Act into law, and it will go into effect on January 1. This bill completely overhauls our criminal justice system and endangers Illinoisans in the process. The SAFE-T Act, or more accurately, the Unsafe Act, ends cash bail in Illinois, making us the first state in the country to do so. Democrats argue that it’s unfair to hold someone in jail because they don’t have the funds to post bail. But what is truly unfair is how innocent Illinoisans will be put in harm’s way as dangerous criminals will now be set free in our neighborhoods because of this bill. Lauren Underwood refuses to tell voters where she stands and continues to vote with defund-the-police extremists like AOC and the squad, while our families are put in danger by reckless left-wing policies. She has even been campaigning with anti-police radical State Rep. Delia Ramirez. Abolishing cash bail means that any suspected criminal currently sitting in jail awaiting trial will be let out beginning January 1, 2023. It means that people facing charges for violent offenses like fatal DUIs, drug distribution, or kidnapping (just to name a few) will all be scot-free until their trial date. The elimination of cash bail means that the criteria for arresting a suspected criminal will be more difficult to meet, forcing police officers to arrest less suspects out of fear of punishment, essentially handcuffing them from performing the duties of their career. This directly jeopardizes the safety of every man, woman, and child across our state. This is the Democrat agenda, and this is the party of Lauren Underwood. She does not care about your safety or your family’s safety. She does not care about upholding the rule of law, but rather actively seeks to undermine it. The Unsafe Act is a threat to our home, and unless we vote out Lauren Underwood and her Democrat friends in November, Illinois families shouldn’t expect the chaos and crime to subside any time soon. | | Dear friend, After hearing the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade,_ the very first thing I did — maybe like some of you — was call my mom. My mom taught me from a young age that my voice _matters._ She raised me to stand up and speak out when I witnessed injustice around me, and she raised me to fight not with anger, but with love. And in a moment of overwhelming fear and anger and sadness, her words brought me strength. I know that, like me, many of you are looking to my mom for our next steps in the coming months. **That fills me with hope for our future, because there is no better leader in this fight than Patty Pansing Brooks.** My mom has stood on the floor of the Nebraska Legislature late into the night battling horrible bans on our reproductive health care. She has worked directly alongside Planned Parenthood to keep safe, legal abortion in Nebraska. And my mom has made a promise to our district that she will continue fighting with _everything_ she has to protect our reproductive rights. **Friend, if you know my mom, you know she’s _never_ broken a promise.** Our current congressman has already voted to **strip our bodily autonomy** and **restrict our access to necessary health care like birth control.** And now that a _national abortion ban_ is on the table, it’s clear he’ll vote to permanently end our access to potentially _life-saving_ reproductive health care, too. **Friend, we cannot let him keep his seat in Congress this November.** This election, our district has the opportunity to fight back by electing a leader who has advocated at the frontlines for our reproductive rights since the beginning of her career. **[If you agree clean_body: There is no better leader in the fight for our reproductive rights than Patty Pansing Brooks. | = | | Dear friend, After hearing the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade, the very first thing I did — maybe like some of you — was call my mom. My mom taught me from a young age that my voice matters. She raised me to stand up and speak out when I witnessed injustice around me, and she raised me to fight not with anger, but with love. And in a moment of overwhelming fear and anger and sadness, her words brought me strength. I know that, like me, many of you are looking to my mom for our next steps in the coming months. That fills me with hope for our future, because there is no better leader in this fight than Patty Pansing Brooks. My mom has stood on the floor of the Nebraska Legislature late into the night battling horrible bans on our reproductive health care. She has worked directly alongside Planned Parenthood to keep safe, legal abortion in Nebraska. And my mom has made a promise to our district that she will continue fighting with everything she has to protect our reproductive rights. Friend, if you know my mom, you know she’s never broken a promise. Our current congressman has already voted to strip our bodily autonomy and restrict our access to necessary health care like birth control. And now that a national abortion ban is on the table, it’s clear he’ll vote to permanently end our access to potentially life-saving reproductive health care, too. Friend, we cannot let him keep his seat in Congress this November. This election, our district has the opportunity to fight back by electing a leader who has advocated at the frontlines for our reproductive rights since the beginning of her career. = If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your contribution will be processed instantly. | | = = | = = | = = My mom has said this once, but I’ll say it again: We are not helpless. It's official, team—I have my Republican opponent.

We knew that no matter who won, we'd be up against a far-right rubber
stamp for Mitch McConnell’s right-wing, anti-choice agenda.

But Don Bolduc goes way beyond that.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/22112?t=1011&amount=25&akid=5531%2E3611125%2ENfM8Tm ]Before I go any further, I need your immediate help to put us in the
strongest possible position. Please split a donation between my campaign
and Tim Ryan's right now to keep this seat (and our Senate) in Democratic
hands.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/22112?t=1012&amount=25&akid=5531%2E3611125%2ENfM8Tm ]Rush $25

Not only is Don Bolduc a far-right extremist, but he's also an election
denier who said he would "defy the [2024] presidential election results"
if called to do so.

right to elect their Senators.

democracy.

clean_body: | | Friend, Senate Republicans just introduced a national abortion ban. I have said over and over again that our constitutional amendment will not protect us in the event of a national ban. It is urgent that we vote yes on Article 22, the reproductive liberty amendment. We must do more right away. We can’t wait. ** After the Dobbs decision, we knew this was coming. That’s why I introduced a plan months ago. Republicans claimed that they were merely “leaving it up to the states,” but that was obvious BS. They’re coming for our freedom and abortion is only the beginning. We can’t just sit around and wait for an abortion ban to happen. We have to be prepared and proactive. We have to fight back and we no longer can accept electing Republicans. We must elect pro-choice champions. I have already released a plan. I am ready to lead on this issue. If I were Governor now, there would already be several steps I would have taken, beginning with: ** 1\. Ensuring we don't cooperate with out of state investigations. 2\. Updating our extradition last so that people accessing reproductive healthcare or those supporting them can not be extradited. 3\. Building a strong coalition with neighboring states so that we are ready for this moment. In these dangerous times, we must be proactive. We’re not in a wait and see moment, yet we have a wait and see Governor. We have to act immediately to build coalitions with neighboring states. We need new leadership. We need your help defeating Vermont’s incumbent Republican Governor! | | Derek, From the moment this campaign began – and throughout my life – I’ve been driven by the idea that there is no greater vocation than service to one’s country. It’s a message my parents instilled in my siblings and me that I’ve carried with me from the CIA to the campaign trail to Congress. For me, service means delivering results for our community – results that will improve the lives of my constituents. That’s why I led the charge on the bipartisan infrastructure law that will reduce congestion on I-95, upgrade Virginia’s roads and bridges, and support family-sustaining jobs. It’s why I’m leading the charge to ban members of Congress and their spouses from trading stock. And it’s why – as the only Virginian who sits on the House Agriculture Committee – I am working to support Virginia’s producers, protect our natural resources, and grow our economy. clean_body: I'm going to keep fighting. | | | Derek, From the moment this campaign began – and throughout my life – I’ve been driven by the idea that there is no greater vocation than service to one’s country. It’s a message my parents instilled in my siblings and me that I’ve carried with me from the CIA to the campaign trail to Congress. For me, service means delivering results for our community – results that will improve the lives of my constituents. That’s why I led the charge on the bipartisan infrastructure law that will reduce congestion on I-95, upgrade Virginia’s roads and bridges, and support family-sustaining jobs. It’s why I’m leading the charge to ban members of Congress and their spouses from trading stock. And it’s why – as the only Virginian who sits on the House Agriculture Committee – I am working to support Virginia’s producers, protect our natural resources, and grow our economy. There’s so much more I want to accomplish for the Commonwealth, and I’m counting on your support to ensure I can. = With appreciation, Abigail Spanberger = * | | Friends of Mark Warner 1490-5A Quarterpath Road #213 Williamsburg, VA 23185 United States | Click here to . | Paid for by Friends of Mark Warner

Friend,

I won’t lie: When I think about all the terrible things Ron DeSantis has done to Florida and her people during his time as governor, my blood pressure rises. It seems there’s _no end_ to what he’ll do to advance his political career.

He’s vowed to **eliminate background checks and gun permits** across Florida, putting our children and our families in greater danger.

He signed the **most restrictive anti-choice legislation** in Florida’s history since _Roe v. Wade_ , with no exceptions for horrible situations like rape or incest. It’s a monstrous law, but it won him points with Presidential Republican primary voters, so he supports it.

DeSantis signed legislation **targeting LGBTQ+ kids in the classroom** , outright banning any discussion of gender issues and further marginalizing already vulnerable students. We should be nurturing _all_ of Florida’s future leaders, not tormenting them for political gain.

He’s determined to silence _anyone_ who opposes him. name: Maggie Hassan
subject: we have our GOP opponent
body:
It's official, Derek – I have my Republican opponent.
We knew that no matter who won, we'd be up against a far-right rubber stamp for Mitch McConnell’s right-wing, anti-choice agenda.
But Don Bolduc goes way beyond that.
Before I go any further, I need your immediate help to put us in the strongest possible position. Please split a donation between my campaign and CommonGood right now to keep this seat (and our Senate) in Democratic hands. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mha?refcode=20220914_CGVA_Hassan]
Not only is Don Bolduc a far-right extremist, but he's also an election denier who said he would "defy the [2024] presidential election results" if called to do so.
But it doesn't stop there. Bolduc is open to abolishing the FBI and supports repealing the 17th Amendment, which would strip voters of their right to elect their Senators.
This isn't just about keeping this seat blue, it's about the future of our democracy.
But extreme GOP groups are spending over $53 million to defeat me, and it's only a matter of time until the full force of the Republican party floods New Hampshire with millions more to flip this seat.
With The Boston Globe calling me "the most vulnerable senator up for reelection this year" and the Senate majority hinging on this seat, your grassroots support right now could not be more important.
I know you've received a lot of emails from me recently, but the first few days of the general election are crucial, and we can't start off on the wrong foot. So please, split a donation right now and help us to defeat Don Bolduc and defend our Democratic Senate majority this November. #

Hi there,
Lindsay Graham and Senate Republicans just introduced a bill that would ban abortion nationwide.
If it wasn’t clear before, it’s absolutely clear now: **Abortion rights are on the ballot this November.**
Let me be clear: no matter what, I will continue to fight in the U.S. Senate to protect and expand access to safe and legal abortion so no one is denied this essential health care in America.
The decision to get an abortion is an extremely personal choice, to be made solely between a patient and doctor, with the support of friends and family. It is NOT a decision to be dictated by the government.
But Since the overturning of _Roe_ , tens of millions of Americans have lost their right to make decisions about their own bodies. **And if Republicans gain power, they are going to pass a national abortion ban, just like many GOP-controlled states have already done.**
It is absolutely CRITICAL that we continue our hard work to expand our majority this November, eliminate the filibuster, and codify the right to an abortion into federal law.
Thank you for standing with me, and for everything you do to protect the right to choose. If we stand together and show up in November, we can protect the right to an abortion nationwide.
\- Alex Padilla

**I will vote no. Always.**
We expected this given the recent overturning of Roe v. Wade. So as we watch the news unfold, here's where I stand: **Now is the time to reject Mr. Graham’s dangerous ban and instead pass a law to protect women and the right to abortion ****–****once and for all.**

People like my anti-choice opponent, and his extremist allies, want to take personal freedoms and decisions out of the hands of individuals and their doctors and put them into those of politicians.
I've spent my time in Congress advocating for all families, making sure they have equal opportunities and the fundamental right to make their own health decisions. And in my town halls, I have had the privilege of talking and connecting with voters as they share their thoughts and concerns with me. I promise to continue fighting to protect our fundamental rights and freedoms when I'm reelected.

name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: Senate control depends on Florida
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=SdJC0yqZLZl6g4UkXSXQTxf8XvcVl4HG&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend,
Democrats are operating with the most tenuous control of the Senate - split right down the middle at 50-50. So it is essential that Democrats do two things: protect every Democratic seat (like mine in Connecticut), and increase the number of Democratic senators in Congress. We can do that by electing Val Demings in Florida.
Congresswoman Demings is running against Marco Rubio. She was in the lead in this close race - but after Marco Rubio spent $1.3 MILLION on ads, a poll now shows her 1 point BEHIND.
If you're already familiar with Congresswoman Demings' record, I wouldn't be surprised. She's one of the toughest public servants around, with 27 years of police service under her belt. From holding criminals accountable to managing Donald Trump's impeachment trial, she knows how to get it done.
Comparing her record to her opponent's, the choice is easy: While Marco Rubio was plotting to gain power within the GOP, Val Demings was risking her life to keep her community safe. She's clearly the better pick for Florida.
With national Republicans commanding a campaign war chest with tens of millions of dollars - enough to attack me and protect Marco Rubio - Val Demings and I need every bit of grassroots support. Together, we need to raise $20,000 by midnight tonight. **Can we count on you to give?**
Val's problem is Marco Rubio is running ads to attempt to distort her story of police service. Meanwhile, my opponent is a candidate loyal first and foremost to Donald Trump. With Mitch McConnell willing to cut any deal to regain power and push an extremist right wing agenda from the Senate onto the entire nation - including a national ban on abortion, we cannot fail.
If we don't have the resources to act now, we'll fall behind. **That 's why I'm personally asking you to chip in and help us win these crucial races.**
**[Split a contribution of $5 or more- whatever you can spare for this battleground Senate race - to help Val Demings defeat Marco Rubio and protect Connecticut's Senate seat. Together, we will deliver an expanded Democratic Senate majority!](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/rb4vd?refcode=jtk1251-bu-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
Thank you very much,
Dick

subject: Lauren Boebert wants us all to die, and 2023 will be a whole different year if she gets to help pick the House Majority Leader.
body:
Who’s going to run the House?
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, **Lauren Boebert wants us all to die.** No, you didn't read that wrong...In fact, there isn't much that hasn't been said about Lauren Boebert at this point. For a long time now, each time I think this bigoted, classless Congresswoman--who heckled President Joe Biden at the State of the Union while he was talking about his son's death--can't get any worse, she proves me naive yet again. [**Hopefully she will be beaten in her race. But, if not, she MUST remain in the minority. So will you please join us in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to the Democratic Congresional Campaign Committee (DCCC), so they can spend these funds in key House races and help us keep our majority?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3ab3ae1e-bdfc-47a0-b540-5be9d9746c1d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _Whether it's off-roading in Utah, crashing her car and ditching her son and dog in the accident, as well as a sister-in-law in distress, but not before coaching her to lie about Boebert's having been there, to her husband recently crashing his car onto a neighbor's lawn and threatening to kill them, the Boebert family is an example of evetrything wrong with today's Republican Party and our poltiical system in general. This woman should be nowhere near a position of any power. _ Now Boebert has taken it even further. She took her grift to a right-wing authoritarian church where she preached (or, perhaps, babbled): **We are in the last of the last days and the church has a role in ushering in the second coming of Jesus.”**

But it is also an incitement to violence for those listening._ She wants the world to end with Jesus's Second Coming as she'd have it, and for that to happen, we need to die. What message does that send to the mentally unstable individuals watching?? **_We can't have Lauren Boebert in the majority in 2022, we just can't. Because if so, she and Marjorie Taylor Greene and Matt Gaetz and Jim Jordan and Paul Gosar--they will be RUNNING THE HOUSE. If you think Kevin McCarthy will, well, Trump has some classified documents to sell you._** [**Hopefully she will be beaten in her race. But, if not, she MUST remain in the minority. So will you please join us in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to the Democratic Congresional Campaign Committee (DCCC), so they can spend these funds in key House races and help us keep our majority.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tac16f9cc-2fbd-41fb-9baa-e02e64d39708/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [**This is an existential election, my friends, so please dig deep and give to the DCCC if you can.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T221a881c-23aa-43d1-8151-6f7ba640dbdf/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) All my best, Cliff

* **Rick Scott,** Senate Republicans’ campaign chair, who voted against certifying the 2020 election results on January 6th, and has plans to cut Social Security and Medicare if Republicans take back the Senate;
* **Marco Rubio,** Florida Senator, who called the marriage equality bill “a stupid waste of time” and is in favor of complete abortion bans;
* **J.D. Vance,** a celebrity author, MAGA superfan, and Senate nominee who traffics in white supremacist conspiracy theories;
* and **Dr. Oz,** the reality TV doctor turned Senate candidate who owns ten properties and — just like Joe O’Dea — is the top donor to his own campaign;

subject: Top 5 reasons why Christians must oppose Big Government
body:
_**My message to all Christians who love both Christ and liberty. Let us unite to spread the Gospel and make liberty win!**_

Peter,

Here is something you don't want to hear: **YOU, as a Christian, have an obligation to OPPOSE Big Government, taxation, and endless wars. **

Throughout history, tyranny's biggest enemies have been followers of Jesus Christ.

Christians with hearts on fire for both Christ and liberty founded this great country and have helped defeat totalitarian governments like the British Empire, the Soviet Union, and still lead the fight for liberty all over the world today.

[_**The Libertarian Christian Institute (LCI) is a non-profit organization dedicated to making the _Christian_ case for a free society and free markets. Please help us spread our message by making a donation of $25, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or ANY amount here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61287151:68Q5uHVfN:m:1:3253819041:E18B252F63DBA21628FEB24890C4DE8C:r)

What does this obligation mean to you?

It means the world is counting on Christians to fight for liberty, spread the Gospel, and defeat Big Government.

You and I must teach fellow believers how Scripture and Jesus's teachings promote the ideas of peace, voluntary action, and oppose the use of force and theft.

Here are the TOP 5 reasons why Christians must oppose Big Government:

* **Big Government haunted Jesus 's life on Earth:** When King Herod learned of the birth of a Savior, he lashed out in anger, murdered his family members, and ordered the deaths of newborns in Bethlehem.

It was also the Empire that sentenced him to death on the Cross. Fortunately, we know Christ died on that Cross to forgive our sins and give us Eternal Life.

* **Governments despise the Christian faith:** Ever since the birth of the Christian church, our brothers and sisters in Christ have been persecuted for their beliefs. From the Disciples being hunted down and killed after Jesus's Ascension... to modern dictators who ban the practice of Christianity.

You and I must NEVER compromise on religious freedom and fight for it at all costs.

* **Governments wage wars against the wishes of God: **Our Lord is a God of peace. We must not allow tyrants to conduct unconstitutional wars, waste trillions of dollars, and destroy human life.

* **Christian values create free and prosperous societies:** The United States is one of the most successful countries in the world largely because it was founded on the Judeo-Christian values of individual freedom and cooperation. These values keep society functioning and thriving.

* **God teaches us NOT to steal:** Taxation is a form of theft. Governments steal our money, devalue our currencies, and create waste. Or worse... They enrich themselves at the expense of their citizens.

Soon, her doctors noticed a birth defect they warned would result in intellectual disabilities or developmental delays and possibly seizures. The news continued to get worse when doctors told her the fetus had not formed a skull and would survive at most hours, if not minutes, after birth. Finally, she was told that her fetus’s brain matter was leaking into the umbilical sack, which would lead to critical illness or even death for Madison. Doctors advised her to terminate the pregnancy for her own safety, and, with heartbroken hesitation, she agreed. Her abortion was set for June 27th, just 3 days after the overturning of Roe v. Wade.

body:
I am reaching out today because we have an incredible opportunity to elect a real champion for justice and the people
#

Hey there, it's John Grisham.
There aren't many candidates that I go to bat for, but I am reaching out today because we have an incredible opportunity to elect a real champion for justice and the people to the U.S. Senate in North Carolina.
I deeply believe in Cheri Beasley and know she is the woman we need representing the Tar Heel state in the Senate. She understands that the status quo isn’t working for too many families, and she’s not afraid to shake up the system.
[**If you can, please consider contributing $3 or any amount that makes sense for you to her campaign today. This race is in a dead heat, and I promise you that every dollar will make a difference.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-sep22.KSPoKB&refcode=em220914-2-MA&t=1&akid=1729%2E357359%2EIOIKgF)
Look, I know Cheri, and I know she’s not afraid to stand up to the powerful Washington insiders. She has proven throughout her years in public service that she cannot be bullied or intimidated out of doing what is right.
That is why super PACs are pouring limitless sums of money into this race to beat her. They’re already spending nearly $50 million trying to buy this seat.
It’s an all-too-familiar story. In fact, I wrote a book just like this, based on a true story, about how one billionaire bought an election to install his hand-picked candidate on a state Supreme Court.
This seat — and our next Senator’s vote — should not be for sale. That’s why we need to do everything we can to make sure Cheri wins.
So I am asking you: [**Please make a contribution — $3 or any amount you can — to Cheri Beasley’s people-powered campaign. We cannot let Republican super PACs buy this seat with their limitless sums of corporate cash.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-sep22.KSPoKB&refcode=em220914-2-MA&t=2&akid=1729%2E357359%2EIOIKgF)

| Team, With less than 8 weeks until Election Day, I want to share a few of my top priorities for when you elect me AG. **[First, though, I need to ask you to contribute to help me defeat Ken Paxton in November, because I just won’t be able to win without your support.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50717090/366925224/1484719371?amount=5&refcode=ea.138190df-7e34-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.138190df-7e34-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTI0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMzgxOTBkZi03ZTM0LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Yb7He2K2_YRnOms7uzCyydLWKJj0LMqMjaPckaCdgug=)** **1\. I’m running because abortion is health care, it is economic freedom, it is a private decision, and it is a human right — and our GOP elected officials want to strip that human right away.** When their cruel six-week abortion ban went into effect in Texas (well before _Roe_ was overturned), I’d just found out I was pregnant. That made me all the more outraged that our government was trying to _tell me_ what I could do with my body. I was also furious that I’d be bringing my daughter into a world where she’d grow up knowing that politicians could deny her the choice of how her own future would play out. I knew I had to fight back. **We have to protect pregnant patients who need care and protect the doctors who provide it.** **2\. I’m running to uphold America’s promise that each of us can have a say in our government.** Texas Republicans are actively attacking voting rights and making it harder for some voters to cast a ballot. My opponent, corrupt AG Ken Paxton, even tried to OVERTURN the 2020 presidential election and negate the will of the people. I believe that the Attorney General is the PEOPLE’S lawyer, but our current AG established a phony “Election Integrity Unit” whose only real purpose seems to be to target voters of color. It must be disbanded, **and the AG’s office must get back to the work of _upholding_ voting rights.** **3\. I’m running because every Texan deserves to live their authentic life and marry the person they love.** Ken Paxton and the GOP are already attacking LGBTQ+ Texans. Our state is _unsafe_ for some of our friends, family, and neighbors. I find that unacceptable. As AG, I’ll END Paxton’s discriminatory, dangerous anti-LGBTQ+ policies and do my part to protect the rights we’ve fought so long to secure. **Texas _must_ be a state that is welcoming to all.** **[If clean_body: Sharing a few of my priorities. | Team, With less than 8 weeks until Election Day, I want to share a few of my top priorities for when you elect me AG. = 1\. I’m running because abortion is health care, it is economic freedom, it is a private decision, and it is a human right — and our GOP elected officials want to strip that human right away. When their cruel six-week abortion ban went into effect in Texas (well before Roe was overturned), I’d just found out I was pregnant. That made me all the more outraged that our government was trying to tell me what I could do with my body. I was also furious that I’d be bringing my daughter into a world where she’d grow up knowing that politicians could deny her the choice of how her own future would play out. I knew I had to fight back. We have to protect pregnant patients who need care and protect the doctors who provide it. 2\. I’m running to uphold America’s promise that each of us can have a say in our government. Texas Republicans are actively attacking voting rights and making it harder for some voters to cast a ballot. My opponent, corrupt AG Ken Paxton, even tried to OVERTURN the 2020 presidential election and negate the will of the people. I believe that the Attorney General is the PEOPLE’S lawyer, but our current AG established a phony “Election Integrity Unit” whose only real purpose seems to be to target voters of color. It must be disbanded, and the AG’s office must get back to the work of upholding voting rights. 3\. I’m running because every Texan deserves to live their authentic life and marry the person they love. Ken Paxton and the GOP are already attacking LGBTQ+ Texans. Our state is unsafe for some of our friends, family, and neighbors. I find that unacceptable. Peter,

name: Matt Brown
subject: Last Night
body:
| | | Hi Friend, While I’m disappointed in the outcome in our race, I was clear from the beginning that this campaign was never about electing any one person – it was about building a much larger movement. Hundreds of thousands of dollars of corporate, outside money flooded into our race and state legislative races to try to maintain the status quo, but we never stopped fighting. And we have some significant wins to celebrate. Like Jennifer Rourke’s victory. Last night she defeated a right-wing Democrat who posted a picture in [Blackface](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/dSCQfi9FLISmU3ZE3bfPhmzWv06zEUROTshTFInDVOrcsjf6603JGSW3LvAACtZ-gONPdIzEWwMjsxgsQ5uP0RnZh5tgD0sffeVeXapSLxOpgH59c-AQKU3m_Er58bxmV6XDqPolxFB01V8ZeUxLA94oae3wVHsMItG4CbcgiLvG9mlCbl6AlzOLgG5Ce-vo1d7kS_2eAgzUS1TOkVMOzSFtAa069o7LOC8MNcRa8wEJ1xhzsy2PnBI46bBrFpqb_XLeYOsaVU7Ny3idkB2M_EXBBqRqofOv6aKIONzse0KYzSpPA_E4z_N81YXVt7sR/3pg/zrd_UHO_R3iRyGPu2rEwPw/h0/-tB7Lm437TvZl5IXm18j42HIzuoYnhzRljYLtFLWe4k) as his Facebook profile picture. Jennifer is a working mom and longtime organizer for reproductive justice who will fight for her community every single day in the Senate. Like Jennifer Stewart, a high school history and political science teacher, who was elected to the House last night. She will work tirelessly to make sure that every child in Rhode Island gets a quality education and that we tax the rich and fund our schools. And like Representative Brianna Henries who won reelection last night. Brianna has stood strong in the state legislature fighting for racial, economic, and climate justice at every turn. Last session, she was the primary sponsor on legislation to raise the minimum wage to $19 an hour. **None of this would have been possible without thousands of people volunteering their time, donating, and pouring everything they had into this fight. I am so grateful for all of your sacrifice and hard work.** Over and over throughout this campaign, I have seen the power of people coming together to fight for what’s right. I saw it in the “sleepout” action last winter in protest of the homelessness crisis, as people helped each other in the middle of the night set tents back up that had blown down in a windstorm. I saw it in the Co-op campaigns, as candidates helped each other knock doors, collect signatures, and get through difficult days. We didn’t win everything we hoped to last night, but we have built something powerful here. And we’re just getting started. With gratitude, Matt

# **_Thelander Calls on Pingree to Support Law Enforcement as Crime Spree Rattles Portland_**
* * *
_If you are able, please join us on the plaza in front of the Portland City Hall this Thursday at 11:00 a.m. Let’s show the men and women in law enforcement that we care about them, that we have their back, and that we will fight for a change._
**_– Ed Thelander_**

**CALL TO ACTION:**

**Ed Thelander Press Conference, Portland City Hall, Thursday, 11:00 am**

**PORTLAND -- **The Thelander for Congress campaign will hold a press conference at Portland City Hall on Thursday, September 15, at 11:00 am.

**_Thelander Calls on Pingree to Support Law Enforcement as Crime Spree Rattles Portland_**

_"According to Portland Police Department data, officers have responded to nearly 50 shootings so far this year. By September of last year, there had been 13 shooting incidents. Much of the blame for this rise in crime can be traced to the policies pushed by Representative Chellie Pingree and her progressive colleagues in Washington."_

Ed Thelander is a 21-year Navy SEAL veteran running for Congress. Volunteer firefighter, reserve deputy sheriff, private pilot and small business owner, Ed resides in Bristol with his wife Lilliana and three children.

WHO: Ed Thelander, retired FBI agent Todd DiFede, retired and active-duty law enforcement members, candidates, and more.

WHAT: Thelander for Congress Press Conference

WHEN: Thursday, September 15, 11:00

WHERE: Portland City Hall, 389 Congress Street, Portland, Maine | |

subject: ACTION ALERT: Protect Oregon's Forests!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Oregon League of Conservation Voters and authorized by Andrea Salinas for Congress
body:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/50719109/366932935/-2116566837?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkyMmViZDIzLTg4MzQtZWQxMS1hZTgzLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=epdNE-TIC8B9j0D6Oi335_Wh4ESaTZwyDrEUatugogU=&emci=69694253-7834-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=922ebd23-8834-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) | | | Dear Peter, After decades of fighting egregious forest management on our state forests, OLCV and our partners, along with the support of Oregon’s people like you managed to pass the historic Private Forest Accords (PFA) legislation. This legislation was over a decade in the making, involving years of negotiations, and its passage finally set Oregon on track for more sustainable and responsible state forest management policies that safeguards threatened species and ecosystems. You may recall taking action on this transformative legislation during the 2022 short legislative session. Well, now the state is in the midst of enacting this legislation through a rule-making process and _we need your help to ensure that new protective rules for our forests are as strong as they can possibly be._ [_**The most direct and effective way you can support this process to shield our state’s iconic forests from destructive logging practices is by submitting public comment to the Oregon Department of Forestry (ODF) and the Oregon Board of Forestry.**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/50719110/366932936/-2116566837?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkyMmViZDIzLTg4MzQtZWQxMS1hZTgzLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=epdNE-TIC8B9j0D6Oi335_Wh4ESaTZwyDrEUatugogU=&emci=69694253-7834-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=922ebd23-8834-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) The new rules released by the ODF are substantial––including protection of waterways with large buffers to better preserve aquatic habitat and drinking water sources, and includes restrictions on roadbuilding––reducing chemical runoff and further fragmentation of forest ecosystems. If enacted as law, **these rules for the timber industry would be instrumental in conserving countless forest ecosystems in Oregon,** so [_**we need you to send a comment to the ODF voicing your support for firm implementation of the new PFA agreement rules.**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/50719111/366932937/-2116566837?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkyMmViZDIzLTg4MzQtZWQxMS1hZTgzLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=epdNE-TIC8B9j0D6Oi335_Wh4ESaTZwyDrEUatugogU=&emci=69694253-7834-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=922ebd23-8834-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) As much as these rules for big timber will better protect Oregon’s forests and vibrant communities of wildlife within them, we still need to let the Board of Forestry know that **while these rules are crucial for the survival of our state’s endangered species, they do not offer adequate solutions to many of the tolls that industrial logging corporations wreak on our climate and ecosystems.** That said, _the PFA is a huge step forward from previously loose restrictions on logging,_ even though we have a ways to go before the logging on Oregon’s state lands is truly sustainable. We need to keep up the fight to justly defend threatened wildlife and vulnerable communities from the climate consequences of industrial logging, but the new PFA rules are meaningful progress towards conservation of our forests and the aquatic ecosystems within them, so **[we must make our voices heard to the ODF and Board of Forestry by asking them to officially implement these rules.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/50719112/366932938/-2116566837?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkyMmViZDIzLTg4MzQtZWQxMS1hZTgzLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=epdNE-TIC8B9j0D6Oi335_Wh4ESaTZwyDrEUatugogU=&emci=69694253-7834-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=922ebd23-8834-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)** Thank you for supporting the natural preservation of our state, Julia DeGraw
Coalition Director, OLCV | |

WEEKLY UPDATE:

There are only 8 weeks until Election Day and momentum is building!

There are so many ways to volunteer and help so please do what you can, when you can. We have so many fabulous opportunities for you to attend this week, check them out below.

September 14th

Candidate Forum hosted by the Lyon Park & Ashton Heights Civic Associations: Sep 14 @ 6:30 at Lyon Park Community Center, 414 N Fillmore St, Arlington. Karina's forum will start at 7:00pm. Come wear your Karina t-shirt and show your support. Parking is on the street. Karina supporters are invited to attend, but only members of the civic associations can ask questions. Let us know you are coming - send us your RSVP at rsvp@KarinaForCongress.com - be sure to put the name of the event in the subject line. If you are a member, let us know when you RSVP.[https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/sn3T7eJo4lTbytVT0sBF9EVsRQ5GhvMnfuZExwChxs-kwxdShOE95FCo1ctNjf0EKB95d_6aN5ByAHwvALXZSMySrQMyqLpDp233IZgrkXtj5KdcqhQv1F4BSGYtvF6Zr0ecgc-nUGqOuai0vkimNx6-f-b2iZQVpDO_UHtjYVN1Yq5A4DnoAI_rcQ]

SATURDAY, SEPTEMBER 17th

Super Saturday Door Knocking: Sept 17 @ 9am - 12:30pm at 3709 13th St N, Arlington. Wear your Karina t-shirt, neat comfortable clothes, and a smile! Some campaign shirts are still available. Come with the Campaign Sidekick app downloaded. Refreshments, training, and support provided. We’ll team you up with an experienced volunteer if preferred. Door Knocking is the most effective use of your volunteer time! Please let us know you are coming so we can make sure we have a mentor for every new knocker, RSVP at rsvp@KarinaForCongress.com (Be sure to include the date and event name in the subject line, and tell us if you are a mentor or new knocker)

Half Way to St Pats Day Festival: Sep 17 @ 12-6pm at Waterfront Park 1A Prince St, Alexandria. WE NEED VOLUNTEERS to help at the Karina For Congress table. If you can help us, email Volunteer@KarinaForCongress.com. Even if you can't volunteer, please come enjoy the food, drink, merchandise and Irish entertainment! Wear your Karina t-shirt and show your support (the best way to get Karina's name in front of the most people is to be a walking sign)!

[https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/8VqbPR6hwJJbJTugruJKePbBhSQeQzPXuCAK6ZVzPdRYp9e2aq_oV34h6waDFYaQ_XZqjGTcbGX5pIYIXX1vVb_HE1yYpjMbhJwW2nSoTgrYQ4qJT8PaeLgrRZLg0Q01yyH28zpt8yvsxmPLGfOvUnw1AOCTDtkwxGNPbTHqlKgGQAw4aTEHRraiiQ]

MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 19th

Conversations With Karina - Supporting Veterans & Public Safety: Sep 19 @ 6-7:30pm at Rebellion on the Pike 2900 Columbia Pike, Arlington. Special Guest: Ron Vitiello, Former Acting Director of ICE. Hosted by the Veterans For Karina Coalition and the Law Enforcement for Karina Coalition. Cost: Free. Let us know you are coming - send us your RSVP at rsvp@KarinaForCongress.com. Be sure to include the date and event name in the subject line. This event is open to the public. Please share the flyers and invite your friends and family to come have a conversation with Karina

[https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/LtZzdsEDn7yunxcK74EQccpbgKUDThbiGDRUaGjWAiTwRcSHMEwiIIzl3rVWaQ_FHyGqeyW2N1OJ1ZJcPGvQiaFRGaHZyVtdUcD4C9HIxQylSWZER4vJwrOKnRKNB358cTVvk8XFvMAArhFCgqOs-S6w1Zag2CHvwxt--JtmIkIvk88RMUm7flPImQ]

Be sure to follow Karina on Twitter (https://twitter.com/KarinaCongress), Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/karinaforcongress/), and Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/KarinaforCongress). Please "like", "share" and/or "retweet" to get her message out to everyone.

| | Peter,

The extreme far-left is making our communities less safe, plain and simple. And in Illinois, it’s about to become a safe haven for criminals.

Help us make sure voters in the 6th district know what we’re up against – join our team with a gift of just [$55](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=89298916c1&e=7dd0b93d07) today!

[I spoke with Charlie Kirk](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=5791ff5148&e=7dd0b93d07) about what the Safe-T Act means for our community – Sean Hannity and [Greg Gutfeld](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=bdebb84737&e=7dd0b93d07) helped make it a national conversation.

| [ ](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=d49d49e49b&e=7dd0b93d07)
---
| Once the SAFE-T Act goes into effect in 2023, cash bail will be eliminated for just about every offense, including kidnapping, armed robbery, second degree murder, drug induced homicide, aggravated DUI, threatening a public official, and aggravated fleeing and eluding.

Plus, offenders released on electronic monitoring have to be in violation for 48 hours before law enforcement can act—meaning they can basically get to Alaska before the police can even step in!

But the scariest part of this extreme piece of legislation is that law enforcement will no longer be able to remove trespassers from your property as a homeowner and business. It’s about to be free reign for criminals in IL-6 and across the state.

**With Nancy Pelosi and Sean Casten in control of the House, we could begin to see extreme legislation like the SAFE-T Act make its way to Washington. We have to flip the House!**

Can you [give $55 TODAY ](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=4d96a6ff44&e=7dd0b93d07)so we can put up a strong fight over the next 55 days of the campaign to keep our families safe?

| [Give $55 to Help Over the Next 55 Days](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=202bc1971c&e=7dd0b93d07 "Give $55 to Help Over the Next 55 Days")
---
| Policies supported by Sean Casten, Nancy Pelosi, and Joe Biden have led to record inflation, a struggling economy, and a country that is less safe. It’s about to get worse unless you join our campaign by [investing $55 so we can put people over politics and win back the 6th District](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=175248bef6&e=7dd0b93d07).

Think about your family, neighborhood, and community—we need to do everything we can to keep our community safe.
Thank you,

Keith Pekau

Peter,
We’re nearing the end of September — that means a few things.

body:
We’re answering some of your most common questions about abortion funds. | | | Peter, In Monday’s email, before we knew of the national abortion ban Lindsey Graham would introduce in the U.S Senate, we announced that this week our emails will focus on the fight for abortion access. With a national ban now being debated in the Senate, as well as West Virginia passing a statewide ban yesterday, these conversations are as urgent as ever — and we can’t talk about that fight without talking about abortion funds. Below we answered some of the most common questions we’ve received about what abortion funds do and why they’re important. If you don’t have time to read through these questions, but are ready to support these vital on-the-ground organizations, **[you can split a donation between 90 abortion funds and pro-choice organizations here.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wIZJtmShspGIpg1kDmsbOYk1lmgXcpR0X-6VXlzNUupC84p0dvyNM3Go-NIPc486_wtEpGFu0E7hoDPCW39X-8_tMghHX8kgId6eImqtccXii3CQ169O2voo3YMz_EcwYSuBtR305-fCt3SEJj7paLFpsn7IixmcMxmKyVnS0FDLz8Pk0uBN1KpKVD-8kkCcreGF1_wUMRsfTl1xFWEucTEltRFS1TdepKiOXanrXrx_H6mX6Zp1sJPFCzjZPvtODZNGFzbTQI5HacVOgOcmnEwsL8msXGckzTp_F3qO27PzwEaUmuus2I3pUU-rIdgKxeLsx3z47Kt6jSlI_bCbs4niFIOzB8NWhxj0NDilRGrw/3pg/z2rMhlY1TiSGKUBGA7LBeg/h0/EZM3JNmsx4_w5ji1CcSgdeNzHr6ZTWdc_bHL9rU05Yw)** **[Donate Now »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wIZJtmShspGIpg1kDmsbOYk1lmgXcpR0X-6VXlzNUupC84p0dvyNM3Go-NIPc486_wtEpGFu0E7hoDPCW39X-8KA6SzDFPrqd7bF509tcfqpjBiZpIeBAAUnxR-Gwh9XwMIjyPGxi4PcDFOE_PGJIPFW_3eMtBg7QGrMVwK0zupga3W4Mf1Yjlhj9TmZw5ev6qjyWJUg_Jecq8f5qHiyA9mpIH3aagwFlNvPN5YSkX6PUaMa8Z--idnMNNecO_lapBOJjPp8d4mOGhRJCix4vCPk-iwREqkwC8JMY8tqgtKTAz4Pegt7lMnWKED096_WbPAL-43V3RdL27e-9hI-sjMcHAYXn4rahTHVrnW22l2g/3pg/z2rMhlY1TiSGKUBGA7LBeg/h1/HyYNPKoKPxR7NP1G8VTWpze6OxLkwlGnWV_gScnzclA)**
* * *
**What is an abortion fund?** Abortion funds work directly with patients and clinics to manage financial or logistical barriers around abortion care, primarily by helping pay for abortion services. They are usually volunteer-run and rooted in their respective communities as a form of mutual aid — many have been around in some form for decades. In many cases, abortion funds work together regionally to support patients. **Do abortion funds just pay for abortions?** Not necessarily! Some abortion funds offer child care, transportation to and from appointments, lodging if a patient has to travel, and other practical support services. **How do they work?** Many abortion funds have hotlines (or “coldlines,” a phone number that is not staffed 24/7) for patients to reach out to begin the intake process. Abortion funds do not make patients prove their need — as a form of mutual aid, abortion funds trust the people reaching out to them — and do not require proof of citizenship. Fund volunteers return calls to patients and have to work with the patient, clinic, and other funds to try and cover the costs of the procedure. Most abortion funds are not able to pay for a patient’s entire procedure — they can only provide some financial assistance. Many times, patients must reach out to various funds to try and receive aid. Even then, most funds have to limit how much they give each patient in order to help as many patients as possible. And it’s not uncommon for funds to have to turn patients away due to a lack of resources, often leaving patients with few other options. **Why do abortion funds exist?** Even before the _Dobbs_ decision overturned _Roe_ , it was not easy for everyone to get an abortion in the United States — especially for those from historically marginalized communities, who often faced multiple barriers to abortion care. According to Planned Parenthood, an abortion can cost up to $750 in the first trimester and up to $1,500 later in pregnancy.1 As the cost rises as the pregnancy proceeds, this adds an additional financial burden to patients who have to coordinate child care, time off of work, and traveling across states. Additionally, there are only 16 states where Medicaid helps pay for all or part of a “medically necessary” abortion.2 This lack of support from the government creates even more financial barriers for the folks living in the other 34 states. **Why should I donate to abortion funds?** Abortion funds provide direct aid to patients. From July 2019 to June 2020, 90 abortion funds across the country were able to help 81,692 people, according to the National Network of Abortion Funds — _but that’s only 35% of the 229,510 calls their network received that year._ 3 As previously mentioned, it is rare that abortion funds can afford to cover the cost of an entire procedure. Yet, abortion funds are on-the-ground and ingrained in their communities more than larger organizations can be. When you donate to an abortion fund, you can trust that your funds will be used to directly support patients. **[Which is why we’re asking if you can split a donation of any amount today among 90 abortion funds across the country. These groups are working harder than ever to ensure everyone who needs an abortion can get one.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wIZJtmShspGIpg1kDmsbOYk1lmgXcpR0X-6VXlzNUupC84p0dvyNM3Go-NIPc486_wtEpGFu0E7hoDPCW39X-8FF5x0Qrx7Cx3Vt2qiPKiOGlELPnl2EFKtH3uGg9JZ1MDcs_tlt-fWs3j5utwVLdu5oIWIufe9Yf1SrNOc3epS2B4mP1FMlH54o8AZb4WZtnW4UyNn0YPOxQZV-5bASLrOdf32tiBfuR2Q3KB7I3f53KBms0MjSIbaJUaMoqc_UF-GQTqe114Awd_NZSdjtWRDb4qh0ma3F9L1WXPxQZlslfDCyQ3Vb5QnX9zBKB75f4GH-wNaYmtcpAjQginw3HHhQU2_RMhNQt71Ph3FpRZgA/3pg/z2rMhlY1TiSGKUBGA7LBeg/h2/HKaMCJRl1kzc0dcJqSrEjwpXsxI_IGYDn0AR0HnHJAw)** **[Donate Now »****](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wIZJtmShspGIpg1kDmsbOYk1lmgXcpR0X-6VXlzNUupC84p0dvyNM3Go-NIPc486_wtEpGFu0E7hoDPCW39X-8Cl1tp2i9jWkdmdwGDu596UkSyegboouSJdrFSVZ3Co104kEDvjBu05NZ8PovkemXNlYvtDmWNWiJwnl9Gwyap6IthKGvYKWwygkIvT22ZbnqclHEqoo_CNDlCrRSmM778sDuhj6D3qyrxt9qQtH-bDxfMBqHuCP27WR92iGPf9rhZAP-W82OkHWjdSwFPXG_V0SefeNAQEtv2EkYNtTNWKEGyLfm-OXwvJLBwcYJx5_JsU17bx_lbWlodz-aypxW-9AFhwzTF7xPrLZnlY9lTg/3pg/z2rMhlY1TiSGKUBGA7LBeg/h3/aOJ2sUO7Mcc-00jYk8CmCgfjxE8ttfYPZNk_6HZj6U4)** Thank you for supporting this critical work, Peter. —Team WFP P.S. clean_body: We’re answering some of your most common questions about abortion funds. | | | Peter, In Monday’s email, before we knew of the national abortion ban Lindsey Graham would introduce in the U.S Senate, we announced that this week our emails will focus on the fight for abortion access. With a national ban now being debated in the Senate, as well as West Virginia passing a statewide ban yesterday, these conversations are as urgent as ever — and we can’t talk about that fight without talking about abortion funds. Below we answered some of the most common questions we’ve received about what abortion funds do and why they’re important. If you don’t have time to read through these questions, but are ready to support these vital on-the-ground organizations, What is an abortion fund? Abortion funds work directly with patients and clinics to manage financial or logistical barriers around abortion care, primarily by helping pay for abortion services. They are usually volunteer-run and rooted in their respective communities as a form of mutual aid — many have been around in some form for decades. In many cases, abortion funds work together regionally to support patients. Do abortion funds just pay for abortions? Not necessarily! Some abortion funds offer child care, transportation to and from appointments, lodging if a patient has to travel, and other practical support services. How do they work? Many abortion funds have hotlines (or “coldlines,” a phone number that is not staffed 24/7) for patients to reach out to begin the intake process. Abortion funds do not make patients prove their need — as a form of mutual aid, abortion funds trust the people reaching out to them — and do not require proof of citizenship. Fund volunteers return calls to patients and have to work with the patient, clinic, and other funds to try and cover the costs of the procedure. Most abortion funds are not able to pay for a patient’s entire procedure — they can only provide some financial assistance. Many times, patients must reach out to various funds to try and receive aid. Even then, most funds have to limit how much they give each patient in order to help as many patients as possible. And it’s not uncommon for funds to have to turn patients away due to a lack of resources, often leaving patients with few other options. Why do abortion funds exist? Even before the Dobbs decision overturned Roe , it was not easy for everyone to get an abortion in the United States — especially for those from historically marginalized communities, who often faced multiple barriers to abortion care. According to Planned Parenthood, an abortion can cost up to $750 in the first trimester and up to $1,500 later in pregnancy.1 As the cost rises as the pregnancy proceeds, this adds an additional financial burden to patients who have to coordinate child care, time off of work, and traveling across states. Additionally, there are only 16 states where Medicaid helps pay for all or part of a “medically necessary” abortion.2 This lack of support from the government creates even more financial barriers for the folks living in the other 34 states. Why should I donate to abortion funds? Abortion funds provide direct aid to patients. From July 2019 to June 2020, 90 abortion funds across the country were able to help 81,692 people, according to the National Network of Abortion Funds — but that’s only 35% of the 229,510 calls their network received that year. 3 As previously mentioned, it is rare that abortion funds can afford to cover the cost of an entire procedure. Yet, abortion funds are on-the-ground and ingrained in their communities more than larger organizations can be. When you donate to an abortion fund, you can trust that your funds will be used to directly support patients. Thank you for supporting this critical work, Peter. —Team WFP P.S. If you’re interested in learning more about abortion funds and how to get involved, please check out the 1\. , Planned Parenthood , April 29, 2022. 2\. , National Network of Abortion Funds. 3\. , National Network of Abortion Funds. Our communities need action, not empty platitudes.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50712171/366907883/333259033?refcode=em_220914_guncontrol_rs2&sourceid=1031507&ms=em_220914_guncontrol_rs2&refcode2=cfaf3f34-7034-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZmFmM2YzNC03MDM0LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fpsFKO2reTcFesyG8e9mjiu-FTpD1gGsanxCfFM7PNc=)
